title: Estes Rockets: Dear Mr. Estes
body_html:
Estes Rockets: Dear Mr. Estes takes readers back to the beginning of the company that helped make model rocketry a worldwide hobby. Written by Vernon “Vern” Estes and Betty Estes Geer, this 250-page paperback shares the story of how a farm boy from Missouri helped build a legacy that continues to inspire rocketeers today.

From Denver to Penrose

The story begins in May 1958, when the company was launched in Denver, and follows Vern and Gleda Estes through August 1961, when they landed in Penrose. Along the way, readers get a close look at the risks, long days, and determined problem-solving that shaped the earliest years of Estes Industries.

The People Behind the Rockets

Dear Mr. Estes is not just a company history. It is a personal story about commitment, sacrifice, invention, and the belief that model rocketry could become something much bigger than a small business idea.

A Story Every Estes Fan Will Appreciate

Readers will learn more about Vern and Gleda’s background, the struggles they faced, and the breakthrough that became key to their success. The book also shares how Mabel, one of the most important pieces of the Estes story, nearly destroyed the company before helping it grow into the name rocketeers know today.

The Lance MGM-52 captures the unmistakable proportions of a tactical missile in a large, eye-catching model rocket. Its 28.75-inch length and wide 2.6-inch diameter create an imposing silhouette that stands out on display and demands attention on the launch pad.

A Rewarding Skill Level 2 Build

Designed for builders ready to take on a more involved project, the Lance MGM-52 provides a satisfying Skill Level 2 building experience. Careful assembly and finishing allow you to bring out the sharp lines and mission-ready character of this distinctive design.

Powerful Flights on D Engines

Recommended for D12-5 and D12-7 engines, the Lance MGM-52 delivers the dramatic liftoffs and strong flights that make larger-diameter rockets so exciting to launch. Quantities are limited to our remaining inventory from The Launch Pad, and no additional kits will be available once this supply is sold.

title: BOLO
body_html:
Built to Make an Impression

Standing 27.25 inches tall, the BOLO has the size and presence to stand out in any model rocket collection. Its slim 1.6-inch diameter gives the finished rocket a clean, purposeful silhouette that looks ready for action from the moment it reaches the pad.

Step Up to D Engine Power

Recommended Estes D12-3 and D12-5 engines give the BOLO the power needed for memorable flights. Its Skill Level 2 classification makes it an approachable next project for builders who are comfortable with basic construction and ready to take on a larger rocket. A 3/16-inch launch rod is recommended.

A Discontinued Kit with Limited Availability

The BOLO is part of the remaining inventory from The Launch Pad, a former manufacturer known for distinctive model rocket designs. Estes will not be restocking this kit after the current supply is sold, giving collectors and active flyers a limited opportunity to add the BOLO to their fleet.

title: Martel AS.37
body_html:
A Commanding Addition to Your Fleet

The MARTEL AS.37 from The Launch Pad offers the substantial size and distinctive appearance experienced builders look for in a memorable model rocket. Its 27-inch length and broad 2.6-inch diameter create an imposing silhouette that stands out on display and at the launch field.

A Rewarding Skill Level 3 Build

Designed for modelers ready to take on a more involved project, the MARTEL AS.37 is rated Skill Level 3. The finished rocket rewards careful craftsmanship with a detailed, display-worthy model that looks every bit as impressive before launch as it does climbing into the sky.

Built for D-Powered Flight

The MARTEL AS.37 is designed to fly on a recommended D12-5 engine, providing the power needed to send its large profile skyward. This discontinued kit comes from Estes' limited remaining inventory of The Launch Pad products and will not be restocked once our supply is depleted.

title: Perseus II
body_html:
Distinctive Military-Inspired Styling

With its long, slender body, contrasting black and light blue finish, and U.S. Navy markings, the Perseus II commands attention before it ever reaches the launch pad. Multiple fin surfaces and carefully balanced proportions give the finished model a technical, high-performance appearance that stands apart in any rocket collection.

A Rewarding Skill Level 3 Project

The Perseus II is designed for experienced modelers who enjoy a more detailed and involved building process. At 26.25 inches long with a 1.6-inch diameter, it offers plenty of presence on the workbench while providing an exciting opportunity to showcase careful assembly and finishing skills.

D Engine Power for Memorable Flights

Recommended D12-5 and D12-7 engines give the Perseus II the power needed for confident, attention-grabbing launches. Whether displayed between flights or prepared for its next trip skyward, this limited model rocket captures the character and excitement that made The Launch Pad kits favorites among dedicated builders.

title: Anubis
body_html:
A Striking Design Built to Stand Out

The Anubis combines a sleek, elongated body with an intricate fin configuration that gives the rocket an unmistakable presence. Measuring 24.75 inches long and 1.6 inches in diameter, it offers an impressive scale without becoming too large for a day at the launch field.

Bring D-Powered Excitement to the Launch Pad

Recommended for D12-3 and D12-5 engines, the Anubis is made for rocketeers who enjoy the deeper roar and commanding liftoff of D-powered flight. Its dramatic shape makes every stage of the experience memorable, from construction and finishing to countdown and launch.

A Final Opportunity to Own the Anubis

This model comes from the remaining inventory of The Launch Pad, a company remembered for its distinctive and highly detailed rocket designs. Quantities are limited, and once Estes sells through its available inventory, the Anubis will not be restocked.

title: Hellfire AGM-114A
body_html:
Command Attention on the Launch Pad

With its rugged military styling and unmistakable silhouette, the HELLFIRE AGM-114A brings a powerful tactical presence to your model rocket fleet. The olive drab body, bold U.S. Army lettering, and distinctive fin configuration create a realistic look that is equally impressive in flight or on display.

A Substantial Military-Inspired Model

At 23 5/8 inches long and 2.6 inches in diameter, this model has the size and visual impact to become a centerpiece in your collection. A recommended D12-3 engine provides the power for a memorable launch while complementing the rocket's commanding design.

Limited Remaining Inventory

The HELLFIRE AGM-114A comes from the remaining inventory of The Launch Pad, a manufacturer known for distinctive military-inspired model rocket kits. Estes has only a limited quantity available, and this model will not be restocked after the current inventory has been sold.

title: Maverick AGM-65B
body_html:
A Striking Military Inspired Design

Modeled after the AGM-65B Maverick air-to-ground missile, this distinctive rocket captures the character of its full-size inspiration with a rounded nose, large swept fins, and a clean white and gray color scheme accented in deep blue. The result is an impressive model with a bold military profile that stands apart in any rocket collection.

A Limited Find from The Launch Pad

The Maverick AGM-65B comes from the remaining inventory of The Launch Pad, a manufacturer remembered for its military inspired model rocket kits. Estes has only a limited number available, and our supply cannot be replenished after it sells through. For longtime collectors, military aviation enthusiasts, and builders searching for an uncommon project, this is an opportunity that will not come around again.

title: Pro Series II™ Vogel™ Peak Performance Bundle
body_html:
Take Your Rocketry to Peak Performance

The Pro Series II™ Vogel™ Peak Performance Bundle is built for rocketeers ready for something bigger, more powerful, and more rewarding. Standing an impressive 64.5 inches tall, the two-stage Vogel™ commands attention before the countdown even begins, then delivers the kind of performance that makes the entire build worthwhile.

With the right engine configuration, the Vogel can soar to altitudes up to 2,000 feet. This bundle pairs that performance with the equipment and launch supplies needed to experience two E16-powered, two-stage flights, giving you a complete setup designed around one extraordinary rocket.

Featuring the Pro Series II™ Launch Rail for the First Time in a Bundle

This is the first Estes bundle to include the Pro Series II™ Launch Rail, and it transforms the Vogel experience from the ground up. The six-foot, two-piece extruded aluminum rail provides long, stable guidance for larger rockets and is compatible with standard 1010 rail buttons and guides.

Its all-metal construction, fiberglass-reinforced nylon components, and stainless steel blast deflector are built for the demands of serious rocketry. Six preset launch angle positions give you flexibility at the field, while the rail can rotate down for easier rocket loading.

When launch day is over, the system disassembles easily for transportation and storage, making it practical for trips to your favorite launch site or rocketry club events.

Two Stages, Two Engines, One Unforgettable Liftoff

The Vogel is designed to reward experienced builders with a launch every bit as impressive as the rocket itself. This bundle includes two E16-0 booster engines and two E16-6 upper-stage engines, giving you the power for two complete two-stage flights.

At ignition, the booster sends the Vogel climbing skyward before the upper stage takes over and continues the ascent. Separate 15-inch and 18-inch parachutes recover the booster and upper stage, bringing both sections back for another trip to the pad.

A Launch Setup Built Around the Vogel

Instead of assembling your high-performance launch setup one component at a time, the Peak Performance Bundle brings the major pieces together in one package. Along with the Vogel Rocket Kit and Pro Series II™ Launch Rail, you'll receive a Pro Series II™ Launch Controller, four engines, four starters, eight starter plugs, and 225 sheets of recovery wadding.

Once your Vogel is built and finished, you'll have the launch hardware and consumable supplies ready for two E16-powered, two-stage missions. It is an ideal setup for experienced rocketeers looking to move beyond smaller launches and into the capabilities of the Pro Series II™ lineup.

Build Big, Launch Bigger

With laser cut plywood fins, a 2-inch diameter body, a finished weight of 17 ounces, and a towering profile that stretches more than five feet tall, the Vogel delivers a substantial building project with an equally substantial payoff at the launch field.

The Pro Series II™ Vogel™ Peak Performance Bundle combines that challenge with a launch rail designed for larger rockets and the engines to put the entire system to work. Build it, bring it to the field, load the rail, and experience what happens when every part of your launch setup is designed to perform at a higher level.

title: ARC Parts - Centering Rings & Parachute Bundle
body_html:
The ARC Centering Rings & Parachute Bundle was created to help American Rocketry Challenge teams stay focused on the build, not the parts search. As teams test ideas, adjust designs, and prepare for launch day, having the right centering rings, transition, and parachute on hand can make the process smoother from the first dry fit to final assembly.

Built for Student Rocketry Design

The American Rocketry Challenge is the world's largest student rocketry challenge, and every successful team knows that small parts can make a big difference. This bundle gives students and mentors useful components for BT-70 and BT-80 based designs, especially when working with 24 mm motor mounts.

Key Parts for Custom ARC Builds

Each bundle includes two BT-80 24 mm centering rings, two BT-70 24 mm centering rings, one BT-70 to BT-80 transition, and one 15 inch ripstop parachute. Together, these parts help teams support motor mount construction, tube transitions, and recovery system planning in a convenient, team-friendly pack.

Support Every Test, Tweak, and Countdown

ARC teams build through iteration, and this bundle helps keep momentum going as students make adjustments and prepare for their next flight. Whether used for a primary build, a backup design, or a last-minute repair, the ARC Centering Rings & Parachute Bundle is a smart addition to any team workbench.

title: Centering Ring Aligner Tools
body_html:
Clean, straight centering ring installation is the foundation of a great flying rocket. The Centering Ring Aligner Tools are designed to help builders achieve precise alignment every time, resulting in stronger assemblies and more reliable flights.

Designed for Accuracy and Versatility

These tools work seamlessly with thick green centering rings, laser cut rings, and engine hook retainers. By holding rings square and flush during glue up, they help ensure motor mounts stay straight and properly seated.

More Than Just a Centering Ring Tool

Beyond centering rings, each aligner doubles as a reliable guide for tube marking, fin alignment, and other detailed layout tasks. This added versatility makes them a go to tool throughout the entire build process.

A Must Have for Any Workbench

Offered in five popular sizes, these aligners support a wide range of rockets, from basic kits to advanced custom designs. If you value clean builds, consistent results, and a smoother building experience, the Centering Ring Aligner Tools belong in your toolbox.

title: PNC-60P Black Nose Cone
body_html:
Whether you are replacing a missing nose cone or turning a new idea into a custom rocket, the PNC-60P Black Nose Cone gives you a versatile BT-60 component to build around. Its streamlined shape creates the classic pointed profile model rocketeers know and love while providing a clean finishing touch at the front of your rocket.

Designed for BT-60 Rocket Builds

The PNC-60P is sized for Estes BT-60 body tubes, making it a convenient option for repairs, restorations, and scratch-built designs. Add it to your collection of model rocket parts so you have the right nose cone ready when inspiration strikes.

Lightweight, Durable Plastic Construction

Its plastic construction offers the durability needed for repeated handling while keeping unnecessary weight out of your design. The black finish also gives builders flexibility, whether you prefer its simple appearance or plan to incorporate it into a more detailed custom finish.

A Practical Replacement and Custom-Build Component

A molded recovery attachment point provides a convenient location for connecting the nose cone to your rocket's recovery system. From bringing an older model back to flight-ready condition to creating something entirely your own, the PNC-60P Black Nose Cone is a useful addition to any model rocket parts supply.

title: Design2Fly™ Builder Kit
body_html:
The Estes Design to Fly Builder Kit gives rocketeers everything they need to turn their imagination into flight. This complete builder kit includes a wide range of tubes, nose cones, engine mounts, parachutes, balsa wood, and more, with enough components to create up to six unique rockets. It’s a fun and educational way to explore rocket design while mastering the building techniques that make model rocketry so rewarding.

Learn by Building

Each rocket you design teaches something new about aerodynamics, structure, and stability. With body tubes ranging from BT-20 to BT-55 and a selection of nose cones and fins, you can experiment with different shapes and configurations to see how they affect flight. The included Model Rocket Technical Manual provides valuable insight into how each part contributes to a successful launch and recovery.

Endless Creative Possibilities

This kit isn’t just about assembling rockets, it’s about designing your own. Mix and match components to create original designs or replicate proven configurations. With multiple parachute sizes and fin sheets included, the possibilities are nearly limitless. Builders can refine their skills and gain confidence with every build and launch.

Build, Learn, Launch

The Design to Fly Builder Kit is more than a box of parts, it’s a complete hands-on learning experience. Builders can explore design principles, test flight performance, and develop problem-solving skills while having fun with rocketry. Whether for personal projects, workshops, or group builds, this kit is the perfect foundation for creativity and innovation in flight.

The Design2Fly Challenge

Build It. Share It. Enter to Win $100.

Now it’s your turn to see where your imagination can take the Design2Fly Kit. title: National Association of Rocketry Mission Inspiration Tee (Youth)
body_html:
The National Association of Rocketry Mission Inspiration Tee gives young flyers a fun, comfortable way to celebrate the thrill of model rocketry. With a bright rocket blasting upward from a bold Mission Inspiration graphic, this youth t-shirt captures the energy and imagination that make every launch feel unforgettable.

Made for Young Rocket Fans

Whether they are watching their first rocket soar or already counting down at the launch pad, this tee helps kids feel connected to the adventure. The youth-friendly design makes it easy to wear anywhere, from classroom STEM activities to weekend launches with family and friends.

A Bold Design With Lift Off Energy

The front graphic features a classic rocket launch scene with bright flames, star accents, and National Association of Rocketry lettering. Set against soft gray fabric, the design stands out without feeling overdone, giving kids a look that is playful, proud, and full of motion.

Comfort for Every Mission

Built for everyday wear, this youth rocket t-shirt is ready for busy days, big smiles, and hands-on discovery. It is a great pick for NAR members, aspiring rocketeers, STEM learners, and any child who loves space, science, and the excitement of flight.

title: Pro Series II™ Pink Flamingo™
body_html:
Big Color, Bigger Launch Energy

The Pro Series II™ Pink Flamingo™ is not the kind of rocket that blends into the background. With its 59 inch tall profile, bold styling, and unmistakable name, this rocket brings a fun, high-visibility attitude to the launch field while still delivering the kind of performance experienced Estes fans expect from the Pro Series II lineup.

From the moment it hits the pad, the Pink Flamingo makes a statement. It is bright, confident, and built for rocketeers who want a model that feels different from the usual fleet addition. Whether you are adding personality to your collection or looking for a crowd-pleaser for your next launch day, this rocket has the presence to turn heads before the countdown even begins.

Bright Style Meets Pro Series II Power

Behind the playful name is a capable Pro Series II model rocket designed for strong, impressive flights. The Pink Flamingo measures 59 inches long with a 2 inch diameter body and weighs approximately 11 ounces, giving it the size and stance to feel substantial without losing the excitement of fast, clean liftoffs.

Flown in its standard single stage configuration, the Pink Flamingo uses Estes E16-6 or F15-6 engines and can reach projected altitudes up to 1,000 feet. Recovery is handled by an 18 inch parachute, bringing the rocket back for another round of launch-day fun.

Fly It Your Way With Adapter Options

For rocketeers who want more flexibility, the Pink Flamingo can also be flown with select 24 mm engines when paired with the 24 mm to 29 mm Engine Adapter, sold separately. With the adapter installed, D12-3 and E12-4 engines become available single stage options, making it easier to match your flight profile to your launch field, engine supply, or preferred altitude range.

That added flexibility makes the Pink Flamingo especially appealing for hobbyists who like to fine-tune each launch. You can keep things lower and more manageable with adapter-supported engine choices, or load up a 29 mm engine when you want the full single stage Pro Series II experience.

Add a Pro Series II™ E2X® Booster for Multi-Stage Excitement

The Pink Flamingo becomes even more exciting when paired with the Pro Series II™ E2X® Booster, sold separately. This booster transforms the rocket into a multi-stage configuration, opening up a wider range of engine combinations and pushing the rocket to even higher projected altitudes.

With the booster added, the Pink Flamingo can reach up to 1,775 feet using an F15-0 to F15-6 configuration. Other multi-stage combinations allow you to tailor the flight, with some configurations using 29 mm engines only and others requiring the 24 mm to 29 mm Engine Adapter, sold separately. It is a rocket you can grow into, experiment with, and bring back to the pad in new ways.

Choose Your Flight Profile

The Pro Series II™ Pink Flamingo™ gives you more than one way to chase the sky. Fly it as a powerful single stage rocket, add the 24 mm to 29 mm Engine Adapter to unlock additional 24 mm engine options, or pair it with the Pro Series II™ E2X® Booster for thrilling multi-stage flights that can reach up to 1,775 feet.

Use the chart below to compare each recommended setup, from lower-altitude single stage flights to the Pink Flamingo’s highest-flying booster combinations. Built for the Pro Series II Launch Field

The Pink Flamingo is designed for use with the Pro Series II™ Launch Pad or Pro Series II™ Launch Rail. It can be launched from a 1/4 inch launch rod or a Pro Series II launch rail, giving experienced rocketeers the proper setup for stable, confident flights.

If you love rockets with personality, performance, and room to explore different launch configurations, the Pro Series II™ Pink Flamingo™ belongs in your fleet. Fly it single stage, add the engine adapter for more options, or pair it with the booster for an unforgettable multi-stage climb. However you choose to launch it, this flamingo is ready to fly high.

title: Apollo 11 Anniversary Bundle
body_html:
Launch Your Own Tribute to Apollo 11

On July 20, 1969, Apollo 11 turned a dream into history as humanity took its first steps on the Moon. The Saturn V carried that mission toward the lunar surface, lifting Apollo 11 into the sky and helping inspire generations to look up, imagine more, and believe that the impossible could become real.

The Apollo 11 Anniversary Bundle lets you celebrate that legacy in your own launch field. Each liftoff becomes a tribute to the mission, the rocket, and the moment that changed space exploration forever. Whether you remember watching the Moon landing, grew up fascinated by NASA history, or want to share the story with a new generation, this bundle turns the anniversary of the moonwalk into an experience you can launch.

The Legendary Saturn V in 1:200 Scale

At the heart of the Apollo 11 Anniversary Bundle is the Saturn V 1:200 Scale Ready to Fly Rocket, a nearly 2-foot tribute to the launch vehicle that carried the Apollo era into history. Fully assembled, beautifully detailed, and ready for liftoff, it gives space fans a way to celebrate the moonwalk anniversary with a countdown of their own.

With realistic scale details, molded plastic fins, authentic markings, and an included display stand, the Saturn V looks incredible on the pad and on display between launches. Powered by a recommended C5-3 engine, this Ready to Fly model rocket can reach projected altitudes up to 200 feet before deploying its pre-assembled 18 inch parachute for a safe return.

Three Saturn V Launches Included

The Apollo 11 Anniversary Bundle gives you more than a single flight. With the included C5-3 Engines and Estes Recovery Wadding, this bundle includes the supplies needed to launch your Saturn V 3 times.

That means three countdowns, three liftoffs, three recovery walks, and three chances to watch the Saturn V rise from the pad. Each C5-3 engine pack includes 3 engines, 4 starters, and 4 starter plugs, while the recovery wadding helps protect the parachute during deployment so each mission can return safely.

Launch Gear for a Complete Mission Experience

Every Apollo-inspired mission deserves a dependable launch setup. The included Porta-Pad® II Launch Pad and Electron Beam® Launch Controller gives you the classic Estes launch experience, from setting the rocket on the pad to pressing the button at the end of the countdown.

The Porta-Pad II provides a stable launch platform for the Saturn V, while the Electron Beam Launch Controller brings the excitement of launch day to life. It is simple enough for new rocketeers and dependable enough for repeat flights, making it the perfect pairing for a bundle built around one of the most famous rockets ever flown.

Bring the Apollo Story Back to the Sky

There is something unforgettable about watching a Saturn V leave the pad, even in model rocket form. The countdown, the ignition, the climb, and the parachute recovery all come together in a launch experience that feels both nostalgic and new.

Whether you are celebrating the Apollo 11 anniversary, giving a meaningful gift to a space fan, or creating a family launch day around one of history’s greatest achievements, the Apollo 11 Anniversary Bundle delivers history, excitement, and inspiration in one unforgettable package. Take your place in the story, begin the countdown, and launch your own tribute to the Moon.

title: Liberty Star™
body_html:
A Limited Edition Rocket for a Once-in-a-Generation Celebration

The Liberty Star™ was created to celebrate America’s 250th anniversary with the kind of launch-day excitement only an Estes rocket can deliver. Its bold red, white, and blue deco scheme brings patriotic energy to every countdown, giving families a thrilling, hands-on way to celebrate that goes beyond the usual fireworks show.

As a limited edition release, the Liberty Star is available only in limited quantities for this historic milestone. It is a rocket made for the moment, combining the pride of celebration with the thrill of liftoff in a design that feels just as meaningful on display as it does climbing into the sky.

Fast Assembly for First-Time Flyers

Designed with beginners in mind, the Liberty Star assembles in under 10 minutes, making it an easy choice for new rocketeers who want to get from box to launch pad quickly. The molded plastic fins help simplify the build while giving the rocket a clean, durable look that is ready for repeated launch-day excitement.

That quick assembly also makes it a great option for families. Parents, grandparents, and young builders can share the experience without getting slowed down by a complicated build, then enjoy the reward of watching their rocket lift off and climb.

Big Performance in a Patriotic Rocket

The Liberty Star may be beginner-friendly, but it still brings the thrill Estes flyers expect. With recommended C11-5 or D12-5 engines, this model rocket can reach projected altitudes up to 920 feet, delivering a strong liftoff and an impressive climb that feels exciting from the moment the engine ignites.

Its 23.9 inch length and 1.64 inch diameter give it a confident presence on the launch pad, while the high-contrast patriotic color scheme helps it stand out before, during, and after flight. It is easy to picture this rocket becoming the one everyone wants to see launch again.

Reliable Recovery for More Launch-Day Fun

After its flight, the Liberty Star returns under a 15 inch parachute recovery system, helping bring the rocket safely back to earth so the fun can continue. It is built for the kind of repeat launches that make model rocketry so rewarding, especially when every flight gives new flyers a better feel for countdowns, liftoff, tracking, and recovery.

A Rocket Worth Remembering

Whether you are celebrating a historic milestone, introducing someone to their first Estes rocket, or adding a patriotic favorite to your collection, the Liberty Star is designed to make the moment feel special. It offers a more interactive way to celebrate than simply watching fireworks, giving families the chance to build, count down, launch, recover, and relive the excitement together.

For launch, use either the Porta-Pad II or Porta-Pad E Launch Pad with the required 3/16 inch Two-Piece MAXI™ Launch Rod. Engines, starters, recovery wadding, and launch supplies are sold separately.

title: 1/4A3-3T Engine Bulk Pack
body_html:
The Estes 1/4A3-3T Engine Bulk Pack gives you the freedom to fly more often with one of the most consistent mini engines in model rocketry. Designed specifically for lightweight rockets, this compact engine delivers a gentle but reliable boost that keeps flights controlled, recoveries easy, and your rockets ready to fly again and again.

What makes the 1/4A3-3T stand out is its consistency. Each engine is engineered to produce steady thrust, helping rockets lift cleanly off the pad and follow a predictable flight path. That kind of reliability is perfect for refining builds, testing performance changes, or simply enjoying flights that behave exactly how you expect.

With a total impulse of 0.625 N sec and a 3 second delay, this engine is tuned for small scale flights where precision matters. The short thrust duration and lightweight design make it ideal for delicate airframes, including balsa and foam rockets, where a softer boost reduces stress and helps extend the life of your models.

This bulk pack is made for rocketeers who want to keep flying without interruption. Whether you are squeezing in flights after work or spending the day at the field, having a reliable stash of 1/4A3-3T engines means more launches, more testing, and more time doing what you enjoy. Always follow Estes safety guidelines and local launch regulations for the best experience.

title: Firecrest™ Bulk Pack (12 pk)
body_html:
12 Rockets. One Unbeatable Launch Day Value.

The Firecrest™ Bulk Pack gives you 12 beginner-friendly Estes model rockets in one affordable, launch-day-ready pack, making it one of the easiest ways to get more people building and flying for less. When you break it down per rocket, the value is hard to beat, especially for families with multiple kids, birthday parties, backyard launch days, or anyone who wants to keep extra rockets ready for the next countdown.

Instead of buying one rocket and deciding who gets the first launch, this bulk pack makes the experience feel bigger from the start. Everyone can build their own, prep their own, and watch their own rocket lift off.

Easy to Build, Exciting to Launch

The Firecrest is designed to give new rocketeers a simple, satisfying first build. Molded plastic fins help keep assembly approachable while adding durability where it matters most, and the lightweight 9.5 inch design is easy for new builders to handle from the workbench to the launch pad.

It is a great choice when you want the hands-on fun of building a real model rocket, without an overly complicated project standing between your family or group and launch day. The result is a rocket that feels accessible, rugged, and genuinely fun to fly.

The Right Altitude for First-Time Flyers

Powered by Estes 1/4A3-3T engines, the Firecrest reaches estimated flights of up to 125 feet. That altitude is one of the biggest reasons this rocket works so well for beginners. It still delivers the thrill of liftoff, the excitement of watching the rocket climb, and the satisfaction of recovery, but it does it in a way that feels easier to track and easier to manage.

For new flyers, that matters. A lower flight can mean less chasing, less worry, and more confidence between launches. The streamer recovery system keeps the experience simple and helps make each flight feel quick, active, and repeatable.

Built for Shared Launch Day Excitement

There is a different kind of energy when everyone has a rocket of their own. Kids compare their builds, families cheer for each launch, and the countdown becomes something everyone gets to experience, not just watch from the sidelines.

The Firecrest Bulk Pack is made for that kind of day. It is affordable enough to share, simple enough for beginners, and exciting enough to create the kind of launch memories that bring people back to the hobby.

For launch day, pair the Firecrest with Estes 1/4A3-3T engines and Porta-Pad II Launch Pad with Electron Beam Launch Controller. Engines, launch system, starters, and other launch supplies are sold separately unless otherwise specified.

title: Baby Bertha™
body_html:
The Estes Baby Bertha™ brings the spirit of the iconic Big Bertha™ to a smaller scale without losing any of the excitement. Measuring 13 inches tall, this intermediate model rocket delivers the same smooth flights and eye-catching design that have made the Bertha series a favorite among rocketeers for generations.

Fast Build, Big Performance

Designed to be built in about an hour, the Baby Bertha™ offers a straightforward and rewarding construction experience. You can customize it with your own color scheme or replicate the classic look from the package. Thanks to its laser-cut balsa fins and blow-molded nose cone, you’ll enjoy excellent flight stability and long-lasting durability.

Exciting Flights and Easy Recovery

Launch after launch, the Baby Bertha™ delivers thrilling results. Powered by Estes standard model rocket engines, it can reach altitudes of up to 575 feet before drifting safely back to earth under its vibrant 12-inch parachute. The smooth recovery system ensures your rocket stays in great condition for future flights.

Perfect for Growing Rocketeers

If you’ve mastered beginner builds and are ready for a bit more challenge, the Baby Bertha™ is the ideal next step. It helps you develop your building and finishing skills while offering an impressive flight experience that’s sure to turn heads on the launch field.

Add to Your Bertha Collection

No Estes collection is complete without a Baby Bertha™. Compact, colorful, and full of character, it’s the perfect companion to the Big Bertha™ and other classics in the lineup. Start building yours today and take your model rocket adventures to new heights.

title: F15-2 Engines (29 mm)
body_html:
Designed for rockets that use 29mm motors, the F15-2 Engines deliver strong lift and a long 3.45 second burn for higher altitude flights and impressive launch performance. Their long burn time keeps your rocket climbing higher, while the powerful thrust curve ensures stable, straight liftoffs. When properly mounted and balanced, these engines support rockets weighing up to 21.0 oz and deliver the kind of performance that keeps you coming back to the launch pad.

The F15-2 Engines are also a great value, combining high performance with consistency you can trust flight after flight. They’re a great choice for larger model rockets, club launch days, and experienced hobbyists looking for stronger lift and longer burn time. You’ll get strong ignition, reliable ejection, and clean recovery timing every time, so you can focus on enjoying the experience instead of troubleshooting.

This pack includes two F15-2 Engines, two starters, and four starter plugs, giving you everything needed for a pair of thrilling launches. It is a convenient way to restock your launch gear or a perfect gift for any rocketeer ready to step up their power. Load them up, prep your rocket, and get ready to feel the roar of Estes performance.

Always follow the recommended installation and safety instructions before flight. Bring power and reliability to your next launch with the F15-2 Engines and enjoy the excitement that only Estes rocketry can deliver.

Officially licensed and developed in partnership with Blue Origin, this 1:200 scale model is inspired by the powerful launch vehicle that reached orbit on January 16, 2025, marking a major milestone in commercial spaceflight.

With more missions planned and growing visibility across the space community, New Glenn represents the next chapter in exploration. This model captures that excitement, making it a must have for space fans, collectors, and rocketeers alike.

Ready to Fly Right Out of the Box

No building, no waiting, and no extra prep required. New Glenn comes ready to fly the moment you open the box, removing the usual barriers that come with scale model rockets. Whether you are new to rocketry or a seasoned flyer, you can head straight to the launch field with confidence.

The included display stand allows you to showcase the rocket between flights, turning it into a striking centerpiece that celebrates modern aerospace design.

Powerful Flights and Smooth Recoveries

On launch day, New Glenn delivers a thrilling liftoff and climbs to projected altitudes of up to 450 feet. It flies on a range of popular Estes engines including B4-2, B6-2, C5-3, and C6-3, making it easy to tailor your flight experience.

Durable molded plastic fins provide stable performance, while a bright 15 inch parachute ensures smooth, visible recoveries for repeat flights you can enjoy again and again.

A Rocket That Performs and Displays Beautifully

Standing nearly 20 inches tall, New Glenn commands attention wherever it is displayed. Its clean lines and recognizable profile make it just as exciting to admire on your shelf as it is to watch soar skyward.

Whether you are launching, displaying, or simply celebrating the future of spaceflight, the Estes Blue Origin New Glenn delivers an unforgettable experience that connects you to the cutting edge of exploration.

title: A3-6T Engines
body_html:
Experience better sight lines and a calmer recovery with the Estes A3-6T mini rocket engine. This 13mm motor is tuned to deliver a short, energetic boost followed by a six second delay, so your model reaches its highest point and then pauses before the recovery system activates. The result is a cleaner, more dramatic flight that is easy to track from the ground.

What makes the A3-6T stand out is its consistency. Estes engines are manufactured and tested to provide repeatable thrust curves and predictable delay times, which means fewer surprises on launch day and more confidence when flying with friends or family. That steady performance helps new flyers learn timing and recovery and gives experienced hobbyists the reliability they need to plan flights precisely.

On the pad the A3-6T feels familiar and safe: a crisp ignition, a confident boost, and a gentle coast that showcases both altitude and stability. It is an excellent choice for lightweight rockets and small payload lofts where visibility and controlled recovery matter. Use it with many of our mini-friendly kits to get the most out of your neighborhood launches or club meetups.

Each pack includes four A3-6T engines and the simple accessories you need to get flying. If you want predictable, fun flights that are easy to track and recover, the A3-6T is a dependable mini motor to add to your launch bag.

title: Astro Assembler™
body_html:
A Rocket You Build Piece by Piece

The Astro Assembler™ reimagines what a model rocket can be. Instead of a traditional smooth body, this rocket is constructed using 3D interlocking puzzle segments that snap together around the body tube. Each piece clicks into place, turning the build into a hands-on, satisfying experience that feels more like solving a puzzle than assembling a kit.

With sixty individual pieces to work with, every step keeps builders engaged. It is approachable for beginners, yet different enough to feel new even for experienced hobbyists looking for something creative.

Make It Your Own

This is not just a rocket you build, it is one you design. The Astro Assembler lets you mix and match puzzle piece colors to create your own pattern, then finish it off with bold, space-themed decals featuring planets, stars, and a playful astronaut.

No two builds have to look the same. Whether you go for clean symmetry or something more imaginative, the result is a rocket that feels personal before it ever leaves the ground.

Designed for First Flights and Big Smiles

With a beginner-friendly build and straightforward assembly process, the Astro Assembler is perfect for new rocketeers ready to move beyond basic kits. It introduces hands-on building concepts while keeping the process fun and frustration-free.

Once complete, this rocket delivers the kind of performance that makes the effort worth it. It launches on Estes B4-4, B6-4, and C6-5 engines and can soar up to 850 feet before deploying its 15 inch parachute for a smooth, reliable recovery.

A True STEAM Experience

The Astro Assembler blends creativity with engineering in a way that naturally introduces key STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics) concepts. Builders explore structure, balance, and assembly while also making artistic choices that shape the final design.

It is a hands-on way to connect science and creativity, giving younger rocketeers a deeper understanding of how rockets are built while keeping the experience fun and engaging from start to finish.

Ready for Repeat Launches

Once you see it lift off for the first time, you will want to fly it again and again. The lightweight design, durable molded plastic fins, and dependable parachute recovery system make it easy to prep, launch, and recover for multiple flights in a single session.

From the first puzzle piece to the final countdown, the Astro Assembler delivers a build and launch experience that keeps you coming back.

title: D.O.R.M. 18™ Launch Set
body_html:
A Real First Launch, Not a Practice Run

The D.O.R.M. 18™ Launch Set is built for people who want to get out and actually launch, not spend weeks figuring out what they need. You get the rocket kit along with the Porta-Pad® II Launch Pad and Electron Beam® Launch Controller, so when you’re ready to go, you’re not stuck piecing together a setup from scratch.

Engines and recovery wadding are sold separately, which is part of the experience. You choose the engine, prep it yourself, and start to understand how each piece affects the flight. That hands-on involvement is what makes the first launch stick.

A Build That Keeps You Moving

This is the kind of build that doesn’t stall out halfway through. The design keeps things straightforward, especially with molded plastic fins that help everything line up the way it should. You’re not fighting the kit just to get a clean result.

It comes together in a way that feels smooth and intentional. You make progress quickly, but you’re still engaged the whole time. By the end, you’ve actually built something, and it shows.

Fast Off the Pad, Easy to Follow

When it launches, there’s no hesitation. The D.O.R.M. 18 lifts clean and accelerates quickly, climbing hard on its way toward 1000 feet. It’s high enough to feel impressive, but still easy to track with the naked eye, which matters more than people expect on their first few flights.

You can follow the entire arc without losing it, from liftoff through coast, right up to the moment it tips over.

Recovery You Don’t Have to Chase

At apogee, the parachute deploys and everything slows down. The bright canopy hangs in the air long enough for you to get your bearings and move toward the landing zone instead of guessing where it might come down.

There’s a rhythm to it. Launch, track, recover, reset. It keeps the experience moving instead of breaking it.

A Rocket That Earns Its Spot in Your Lineup

This isn’t something you fly once and forget about. The D.O.R.M. 18 holds up, flies consistently, and gives you room to experiment with different engines as you get more comfortable. It becomes one of those rockets you bring with you every time because you know exactly what kind of flight you’re going to get.

And more often than not, it’s the one that ends up flying more than anything else in your range box.

title: Pro Series II™ Crimson Fury
body_html:
Crimson Fury was designed to turn heads before it ever leaves the pad. Its aggressive profile, vivid finish, and glossy red nose cone give it a hot rod attitude that instantly stands out at the field. This is a rocket that looks fast sitting still and feels even faster once the countdown begins.

Whether it is your first Pro Series II rocket or the next addition to your growing fleet, Crimson Fury delivers that unmistakable feeling of flying something special.

Serious Power for Serious Flyers

At its core, Crimson Fury is a 29mm powerhouse engineered for strong, stable flights on recommended E16-4 and F15-4 engines. Expect hard liftoffs, clean trajectories, and a flight profile that rewards careful preparation and confident flying.

With projected altitudes reaching around 700 feet, each launch delivers the kind of performance that keeps experienced flyers coming back for one more flight.

Precision Construction You Can Trust

Laser cut plywood fins provide strength, accuracy, and durability where it matters most. This construction helps Crimson Fury hold up to repeated launches while maintaining consistent flight characteristics over time.

The result is a rocket that feels solid in your hands, stable in the air, and dependable flight after flight.

Reliable Recovery for Repeat Flights

Crimson Fury is equipped with the Estes Rip Stop Parachute, designed to deliver smooth, controlled descents and protect your rocket after high energy launches. Watching your rocket drift safely back to earth is part of the thrill, and this recovery system helps ensure it is ready to fly again.

Less worry about damage means more focus on what matters most, prepping the next engine and lining up for another launch.

Designed for the Pro Series II Experience

Compatible with both the Pro Series II™ Launch Pad and Pro Series II™ launch rail, Crimson Fury fits seamlessly into an advanced rocketry setup. It is built to grow with you as you push into bigger engines and bolder flights.

If you are looking for a rocket that blends power, precision, and undeniable style, Crimson Fury delivers a launch experience that lives up to its name.

title: Ghost Chaser™
body_html:
The Ghost Chaser is designed for success right out of the box. This snap-together rocket requires no glue or paint. Just click the pieces into place and apply the included stick-on decals. Even first-time builders can have it assembled and ready for flight in minutes, making it an ideal choice for anyone eager to experience their first launch.

Hauntingly Cool Design

With its shimmering silver-white body and translucent blue fins, the Ghost Chaser lives up to its name. The design captures light beautifully in flight, creating a ghostly trail across the sky. Its clear payload section adds both function and flair, letting you send up small objects or simple experiments for a bit of extra fun.

See Your Experiments Take Flight

The Ghost Chaser’s clear payload section lets you add a personal touch to every launch. Send up a small experiment, lightweight sensor, or your own creative cargo and watch it soar skyward inside the transparent capsule. It’s a fun way to explore the science of flight or simply add your imagination to each mission.

High-Flying Performance

Don’t let its simplicity fool you, this beginner-level rocket delivers big altitude. The Ghost Chaser can reach up to 1100 feet on an Estes C6-7 engine, making every launch an exciting spectacle. For smaller fields, swap in A or B class engines for lower flights that are just as thrilling.

What You’ll Need

Assembly is quick and easy with no glue required, just clear tape and a pencil may come in handy. For launch day, grab an Estes launch system, recovery wadding, and your choice of the recommended engines: A8-3, B4-4, B6-4, C6-5, or C6-7. The Ghost Chaser pairs perfectly with the Porta-Pad II launch pad and Electron Beam controller (each sold separately).

title: Gemini Titan
body_html:
Before the Moon, There Was Gemini

The Estes Gemini Titan represents the program that transformed American spaceflight from experimentation into execution. It was here that astronauts learned how to live and work in space, perform spacewalks, and master orbital rendezvous. These were not just milestones, they were the capabilities that made the Moon landing possible.

This 1:48 scale flying model captures that defining moment with precision and purpose. Designed to reflect both the historical importance and the spirit of rapid innovation that defined the Gemini era, it stands as an essential addition to the Estes legacy, bridging the gap between Mercury and Apollo in a way that has not been seen in decades.

The Rocket That Made the Moon Possible

Gemini was the proving ground. Every lesson learned, every maneuver mastered, and every mission completed built the foundation for what would follow. This model brings that story into your hands, offering a tangible connection to the program that turned ambition into achievement.

For those who know Apollo, this is where it began. For those discovering it for the first time, this is the missing piece that completes the story of how America reached the Moon.

A Defining American Moment

The Gemini program was driven by urgency, ingenuity, and the determination to achieve what had never been done before. It was a time when progress moved quickly and every launch carried the weight of national ambition. The Gemini Titan embodies that spirit. It is not just a representation of a rocket, it is a reflection of a moment when innovation accelerated and the impossible became achievable.

Where Astronauts Became Legends

Before they made history on the Moon, they flew Gemini.

Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, Jim Lovell, Gus Grissom, and others refined their skills during these missions, learning how to operate, maneuver, and endure in space. From the first American spacewalk on Gemini IV to the precision rendezvous maneuvers that made lunar missions possible, Gemini was where experience replaced theory.

This rocket honors the program that shaped these astronauts into pioneers. It represents the proving ground where capability was built, confidence was earned, and the path to the Moon was made real.

Build the Mission That Inspires You

The Gemini Titan was not defined by a single launch, but by a series of missions that each pushed the boundaries of what was possible in space. To honor that legacy, this model includes LV serial number decals for all 12 Gemini flights, giving you the freedom to choose which mission you want to represent.

Whether you are drawn to a specific crew, a historic first, or a personal connection to the program, this feature allows you to make the rocket your own. It transforms the build from a single representation into a meaningful tribute, connecting your finished model to the exact moment in history that inspires you most.

Precision Scale, Built to Fly

At 1:48 scale, the Gemini Titan is crafted to deliver both visual accuracy and real flight performance. From its distinctive profile to its carefully considered details, it is designed to stand out whether on the launch pad or on display.

The included display stand allows the model to be showcased as a true centerpiece, highlighting its proportions and presence when not in flight. This is a rocket that earns its place on the shelf just as much as it does in the sky.

Clustered Power You Can See and Feel

Equipped with a two-engine cluster of C5-3 engines, the Gemini Titan delivers a launch experience unlike a single-motor rocket. As both engines ignite, the rocket rises with authority, leaving behind a distinct twin smoke trail that captures attention from liftoff to recovery. Reaching altitudes of up to 350 feet, the flight is controlled, visible, and rewarding, making every launch feel deliberate and meaningful rather than fleeting.

History That Still Moves Us Forward

The pace and ambition of the Gemini program mirror the modern era of spaceflight, where rapid iteration and bold goals once again define progress. What was achieved then continues to shape what is possible today.

Gemini Titan carries forward a legacy of progress, where each breakthrough builds on the last and pushes exploration further. From the moment it takes shape in your hands to its flight and place on display, it becomes a continuous connection between generations driven by the pursuit of what comes next.

title: Spring Skies Solar Twirl™ Bundle
body_html:
Everything You Need, One Perfect Bundle

Getting into model rocketry should feel exciting from the start. The Spring Skies Solar Twirl™ Bundle brings together everything you need to build, launch, and recover your rocket in one carefully matched setup, so you are not left guessing what to buy or whether it will all work together.

Every component in this bundle is selected to work seamlessly together, giving you a smooth path from your first build to your first launch. It is an easier, more enjoyable way to get started, and an even better way to keep launching.

Instead of piecing together parts, you get a system that is designed to perform as one. It is a smoother path to that first countdown, and an even better experience once your rocket leaves the pad.

A Rocket That Turns Every Launch Into a Show

The Solar Twirl™ stands out the moment it lifts off. Its unique two-fin design creates a spinning flight that is both visually striking and naturally stable, using angular momentum to stay on course as it climbs higher into the sky.

Standing over two feet tall and capable of reaching up to 900 feet, it delivers real altitude without being intimidating to build. It is the kind of rocket that makes your first launch feel like a big moment, and every launch after that just as rewarding.

Take Control of the Countdown

The Porta-Pad® II Launch Pad and Electron Beam® Launch Controller put you in charge of the moment that matters most. Setup is quick, the system is easy to use, and when everything is in place, the focus shifts to the countdown.

Insert the safety key, press the button, and watch as your rocket roars off the pad and into open sky. It is simple, satisfying, and exactly how a launch should feel.

Power That Brings It to Life

The included C6-3 engines deliver the energy behind every launch. With strong thrust and a shorter delay, they send the Solar Twirl skyward with a fast, confident climb, followed by a well-timed parachute deployment that brings everything back down smoothly. It is that instant ignition and surge of power that turns anticipation into action.

Built for Safe, Repeatable Flights

Recovery wadding plays a critical role in protecting your rocket’s parachute during ejection. This flame-resistant material shields it from heat, helping ensure clean deployment and a controlled descent back to the ground. It is a small detail that makes a big difference in how each flight finishes.

Make the Most of Spring Skies

The Spring Skies Solar Twirl™ Bundle is made for those clear days, open fields, and moments where everything comes together. The build, the countdown, the ignition, and the climb all become part of an experience that is easy to get into and hard to forget.

Grab your bundle, step outside, and look up. Your next launch is waiting.

title: The Mavericks™

The Mavericks™ puts two complete model rocket kits in your hands, Rebel and Unruly, each engineered for impressive performance on 13 mm engines. Instead of waiting between flights, you can prep one while the other is in the air. Share one with a friend or keep both for yourself and push your launch day to the limit.

With projected altitudes up to 600 feet for Rebel and 500 feet for Unruly, you will see fast climbs, clean arcs, and thrilling ejections that make every countdown worth it.

The Mavericks is designed for intermediate rocketeers ready to move beyond beginner builds. It adds more advanced construction techniques while keeping the experience approachable, engaging, and rewarding every step of the way.

Laser cut balsa wood fins provide accuracy and a hands on building experience that seasoned hobbyists appreciate. The result is a pair of rockets that look sharp on the pad and perform with confidence in the sky.

Fast Streamer Recovery, More Time to Fly

Built for Repeated Launch Days

Compatible with the Porta-Pad® II launch pad and a standard 1/8 inch launch rod, The Mavericks fits seamlessly into your existing setup. Lightweight yet durable, each rocket is ready to become a regular in your flight rotation.

If you are ready to chase altitude, sharpen your skills, and experience the thrill of flying two high performance model rockets in one kit, The Mavericks™ is your next mission.

title: Mega Mosquito™
body_html:
The Mega Mosquito™ celebrates one of the most legendary rockets in model rocketry history. This limited edition kit pairs the original Mosquito™ with its larger sibling, the Mega Mosquito, giving you a chance to build and fly two rockets that showcase the enduring appeal of this classic design.

Inside the box you will find two complete rockets to assemble and launch. The original Mosquito returns exactly as fans remember it, while the Mega Mosquito delivers the same bold presence that made it a favorite among experienced rocketeers. With its wide 2.6 inch airframe, laser cut balsa fins, and striking yellow and black finish, the Mega Mosquito looks impressive on the pad and even better climbing into the sky.

Two Rockets, Two Unique Flight Experiences

This kit gives you the opportunity to build and fly two rockets that deliver completely different launch experiences. The original Mosquito flies on mini engines such as the 1/4A3-3T, 1/2A3-2T, A3-4T, or A10-3T. Its compact size makes it ideal for smaller launch fields and quick turnaround flights that keep the excitement going.

When you are ready for more power, load the Mega Mosquito with a D12-5, E12-4, or E12-6 engine and watch it roar skyward to heights of up to 750 feet. Its larger airframe, sturdy construction, and 18 inch parachute recovery system combine for thrilling liftoffs and smooth, dependable recoveries.

Designed for Builders Who Enjoy the Process

The Mega Mosquito is designed for intermediate builders who enjoy the hands on process of crafting a rocket from start to finish. Precision laser cut balsa fins provide strength and accuracy while allowing you to shape, sand, and finish the rocket yourself.

The roomy airframe makes assembly comfortable and rewarding as you apply primer, paint, and the signature yellow and black graphics. Every step of the build adds to the satisfaction of seeing your rocket come together and prepares you for the moment it leaves the pad for its first flight.

A Tribute to an Estes Favorite

The Mosquito has earned its place as one of the most recognizable rockets ever created. This limited edition kit honors that legacy by pairing the tiny original with the impressive Mega Mosquito so you can experience both ends of the design in one package.

Whether you are revisiting a rocket you flew years ago or discovering the Mosquito family for the first time, this kit delivers a memorable building experience and exciting launches that celebrate the enduring spirit of model rocketry.

title: Artemis II Countdown Bundle
body_html:
For the first time since 1972, astronauts are heading back on a path toward the Moon. The Artemis II mission will send a crew around lunar orbit aboard NASA’s Space Launch System and Orion spacecraft, proving modern human capability in deep space and paving the way for future lunar exploration.

The Artemis II Countdown Bundle lets you celebrate that milestone in your own launch field. Each flight becomes your tribute to Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen as they circle the Moon and move humanity forward into a new era of exploration.

The Iconic NASA SLS in 1:200 Scale

At the heart of this bundle is the Estes 1:200 scale NASA SLS model rocket, a detailed replica of the Block 1 configuration that is powering the Artemis program. Standing 19.4 inches tall and finished with realistic markings, this pre assembled and pre finished rocket looks incredible on the pad and on display between launches.

Powered by a recommended C5-3 or C6-3 engine, the NASA SLS model rocket can reach projected altitudes up to 350 feet before deploying its vibrant 15 inch parachute for a smooth return. Transparent fins double as a display stand, making it just as impressive on your shelf as it is in the sky.

Everything You Need for a Complete Launch

The Artemis II Countdown Bundle is designed to give you a true launch day experience with everything needed to fly your NASA SLS model rocket. The included Porta-Pad® II Launch Pad and Electron Beam® Launch Controller provide a stable, dependable platform for liftoff. Just add batteries and you are ready to begin your countdown.

You will also receive a pack of C6-3 engines, complete with starters and plugs, delivering dependable high thrust launches with a 3 second delay that is ideal for the NASA SLS. Recovery wadding is included as well, helping protect your parachute from hot ejection gases and ensuring reliable, repeatable flights.

Relive the Countdown Again and Again

There is nothing quite like hearing the final seconds tick away, pressing the launch button, and watching your rocket leap from the pad. With three C6-3 engines in the bundle and enough recovery wadding for multiple flights, you can recreate the excitement of Artemis II more than once.

Whether you are a longtime rocketeer or stepping into the hobby for the first time, the Artemis II Countdown Bundle delivers power, authenticity, and inspiration in one unforgettable package. Take your place in the story of lunar exploration and launch your own mission toward the Moon.

title: Luna Dart™ Launch Set
body_html:
The Luna Dart™ Launch Set is your complete introduction to model rocketry. Built for beginners ages 10 and up, this flying model rocket combines sleek design, reliable performance, and an easy to assemble build that makes your first launch feel like a true mission.

Inside the box, you will find the Luna Dart rocket, a 12 inch parachute recovery system, the trusted Porta-Pad II launch pad, and a launch controller. title: PNC-50BB Nose Cone
body_html:

title: B6-2 Engines
body_html:
The Estes B6-2 is a standard single-stage model rocket engine engineered for reliable, repeatable flight performance. Delivering a total impulse of 5.00 N-sec and a peak thrust of 12.10 newtons (2.7 lbs), this 18 mm diameter engine provides a strong boost phase, making it ideal for rockets with a maximum lift weight of 4.5 ounces (127 g). The 2-second delay allows for a controlled coast phase before activating the ejection charge, helping ensure stable recovery deployment and consistent flight profiles.

With a thrust duration of 0.80 seconds, the B6-2 supplies a quick and powerful liftoff that suits rockets designed for lower altitude flights or those requiring early deployment. This engine is an excellent match for kits where a shorter delay improves flight stability and recovery system timing. Whether used for test flights or routine launches, the B6-2 delivers the dependable thrust curve that hobbyists expect from Estes engines.

Each engine pack includes three B6-2 engines, four starters, and four starter plugs, providing a complete solution for multiple launch setups. The included starters ensure reliable ignition, while the plugs secure the starters in place for optimal performance. This all-in-one package is ideal for rocketeers who want everything ready for their next launch without needing additional components.

Backed by Estes’ legacy of quality and precision manufacturing, the B6-2 engine is trusted for its balanced performance characteristics. Its combination of quick thrust, short delay, and proven reliability makes it a go-to choice for hobbyists seeking consistent results flight after flight.

body_html:

The Shrike combines historic appeal with modern craftsmanship, giving experienced builders a chance to own and fly a piece of rocketry history.

Two-Stage Power and Payloader Design

What makes the Astron Shrike truly unique is its combination of multistage flight and payloader capability. The booster stage provides the extra energy needed to reach altitudes up to 1,500 feet, while the upper stage payload section allows rocketeers to experiment with small cargo or creative mission ideas. This dual function makes it one of the most versatile kits in the series.

Balsa Construction for True Vintage Craftsmanship

The Astron Shrike features a balsa wood nose cone and laser-cut balsa fins, offering builders the classic materials that defined early model rocketry. These lightweight wood components shape beautifully, sand smoothly, and create a polished finish that feels authentic to the era. Combined with modern precision cutting, the Shrike offers both nostalgia and elevated performance.

High-Altitude Thrills

The Astron Shrike flies on standard 18mm Estes engines, with a range of booster and upper-stage combinations. Recommended engines include A8-0, B6-0, and C6-0 for the booster, and A8-3, A8-5, B6-6, C6-5, and C6-7 for the upper stage. With proper setup, you can enjoy dramatic two-stage flights followed by smooth recoveries under the 12 inch parachute.

What You’ll Need

To complete your Astron Shrike build, you’ll need basic hobby tools and supplies: pencil, ruler, masking tape, scissors, hobby knife, carpenter’s glue, fine and extra-fine sandpaper, primer, paint, and an optional clear coat. For launch, pair your Shrike with the Porta-Pad® II Launch Pad, Electron Beam® Launch Controller, recovery wadding, and your choice of recommended engines.

title: Pro Series II™ Li-Po Power Battery & Charger
body_html:
Power your most advanced launches with confidence using the Pro Series II™ Li-Po Power Battery & Charger. This high-output 800 mAh 11.1V 50C battery delivers the precision current required for reliable ignition, even when firing multiple motors simultaneously. Designed for serious rocketeers, it’s built to deliver consistent performance, flight after flight.

Engineered for the Pro Series II™ Launch Controller

This battery was developed specifically to pair with the Pro Series II™ Launch Controller, creating a complete high-energy system that supports advanced ignition and electronic control. Together, they provide the power and precision needed for complex launches that standard systems simply can’t handle.

Essential for Cluster Rocketry

The Pro Series II™ Li-Po Power Battery & Charger is a required component for launching the Estes Timewarp™ rocket and other cluster-engine builds. Its rapid discharge capability ensures that every motor ignites simultaneously, delivering the thrilling multi-engine lift-off that defines advanced model rocketry.

Recharge, Reuse, and Re-Launch

With its included charger, this Li-Po system is ready for multiple launches in a single day. Simply recharge between flights and keep your launch pad ready for the next mission. Compact, efficient, and designed for longevity, it’s the power solution that keeps your Pro Series II™ gear at peak performance.

Your Power System Essentials

Each package includes one 800 mAh 11.1V 50C Li-Po battery and a matching charger. The battery connects directly to the Pro Series II™ Launch Controller, delivering the power needed for clustered ignition systems such as the Estes Timewarp™.

title: TimeWarp™ & Li-Po Power Battery with Charger
body_html:
The TimeWarp and Li-Po Power Battery bundle creates a complete advanced launch setup that brings true cluster rocketry performance within reach. The TimeWarp ignites three mini engines at once to produce an incredible surge of thrust that commands attention the moment you press the button. Pairing it with the Pro Series II Li-Po Power Battery and Charger delivers the consistent ignition current needed for a smooth, synchronized start every time.

Together, these two products form a dependable system that takes your hobby to the next level and gives you the kind of launch power that makes every countdown feel electric.

The TimeWarp Experience

The Estes TimeWarp is designed for rocketeers who want more than a standard single engine flight. Its triple engine cluster fires in perfect coordination to create a balanced climb straight into the sky. With precision cut balsa fins and a bold military inspired look, this rocket has both style and stability. Every detail supports smooth aerodynamic performance that feels refined and controlled on every launch.

Standing 25 inches tall and weighing only 2.5 ounces, the TimeWarp can soar to 500 feet on recommended engines such as 1/2A3 2T, A3 4T, and A10 3T. A bright 15 inch parachute brings it back safely, ready for flight after flight. This is a rocket built to impress both on the pad and in the air.

The Power Behind Advanced Launch Systems

The Pro Series II Li-Po Power Battery and Charger provides the high output energy required for complex ignition setups. This rechargeable 800 mAh 11.1V 50C Li-Po battery supplies steady, reliable current for the Pro Series II Launch Controller, making it essential for rockets like the TimeWarp that use multi engine ignition. Its fast recharge capability keeps your missions moving with minimal downtime.

Every component is engineered to perform. The Li-Po battery is compact, lightweight, and dependable, and the included charger gives you everything you need to power multiple launches in a single day. Rocketeers who demand consistent ignition reliability will appreciate how seamlessly this system integrates into their workflow.

Power and Performance Working Together

When you combine the TimeWarp with the Li-Po Power Battery, you get a launch setup that is ready for advanced rocketry challenges. This bundle includes the high performance cluster rocket and the power system required to ignite it with confidence. It is the perfect choice for anyone ready to experience the thrill of multi engine flights.

Prepare your launch gear, gather your recommended engines, and get ready to feel the excitement that comes from commanding a rocket designed for precision and power. With this bundle, your next flight will be anything but ordinary.

title: TimeWarp™
body_html:
The Estes TimeWarp™ brings a bold new energy to the launch pad. Its three mini engine cluster ignites together to produce an incredible burst of thrust that commands attention and delivers a breathtaking ascent. When the smoke clears, you will know you just witnessed one of the most thrilling launches in model rocketry.

Each flight offers a coordinated ignition sequence that creates a balanced, stable climb straight into the sky. This rocket delivers performance that goes beyond expectation and gives advanced flyers the kind of power that makes every countdown worth the wait.

Built for Advanced Rocketeers

Engineered for serious builders, the TimeWarp rewards careful craftsmanship with exceptional flight performance. Its laser cut balsa fins and aerodynamic body provide smooth, consistent stability while minimizing drag. Every component has been designed to enhance flight precision, making each launch feel professional and controlled.

The bold military inspired design brings a commanding look to the field or your display shelf. The TimeWarp combines aesthetic appeal with real performance, standing as proof that technical precision and striking design can coexist perfectly in one advanced model rocket.

Precision Cluster Launching

The TimeWarp’s triple engine configuration creates synchronized ignition and balanced thrust across all three mounts. To power this system, pair it with the Pro Series II™ Launch Controller and 3 Cell Li Po (11.1 V) Battery. This combination provides the ignition reliability needed for flawless cluster launches and delivers consistent lift every time.

Always use identical mini engines for each flight to maintain even thrust and stability throughout ascent. The result is a launch that is both controlled and powerful, giving you the kind of performance that makes cluster flying one of the most rewarding experiences in model rocketry.

Prepare for Liftoff

Before you hit the launch pad, gather your Porta Pad® II Launch Pad, recovery wadding, starters, and plugs along with your choice of recommended engines including 1/2A3 2T, A3 4T, or A10 3T. The TimeWarp stands 25 inches tall, weighs just 2.5 ounces, and can soar to 500 feet before drifting gently back to Earth under its bright 15 inch parachute.

When you are ready for a launch that delivers pure excitement and precision control, there is only one choice. The TimeWarp is designed to challenge, impress, and reward those who are ready to master the art of cluster flight.

title: B6-0 Engines
body_html:
The Estes B6-0 booster engine is engineered specifically for two stage model rockets where a clean, dependable lift from the lower stage is critical. With a short, energetic thrust curve, the B6-0 gets your rocket to altitude and separates stages with authority while remaining easy to handle for backyard and club launches alike. It is sized for standard 18 mm motor mounts and is intended to be used in combination with a standard delayed or instant upper stage engine.

What makes the B6-0 stand out is its consistency. You can expect the same ignition response and thrust profile from flight to flight which makes staging timing predictable and recovery planning simple. That predictable performance gives you confidence when testing new staging setups or when teaching others how two stage rockets operate. The B6-0 is repeatable, safe when used correctly, and a great engine for learning advanced flight techniques without sacrificing reliability.

Use the B6-0 when you want a strong, short duration boost for lightweight rockets up to about 4 ounces including the engines. Each package ships with the launch essentials so you can prepare and fly quickly. Whether you are refining separation distances, practicing stage ignition timing, or just adding a new layer of excitement to your flights, the B6-0 delivers a satisfying, consistent boost that helps your designs perform as intended.

Always follow Estes instructions and local safety codes when preparing and launching model rockets. Make sure staging hardware is installed correctly and that the booster and upper stage engines are properly secured before each flight. Ready to step up your two stage flights? Add the Estes B6-0 booster engines to your kit and enjoy reliable, repeatable stage performance.

Built for BT-50 Rocket Projects

Whether you are creating a new design from scratch or replacing a missing or damaged nose cone, this pack gives you five compatible options for BT-50 body tube builds. It is a simple way to keep your workbench stocked with one of the most essential model rocket parts.

Keep Building Without Slowing Down

With five nose cones in each package, the NC-50 Nose Cone pack is ideal for hobbyists who always have another idea taking shape. Add them to your parts bin and be ready for repairs, upgrades, and custom BT-50 rocket designs whenever inspiration strikes.

title: Premier Rocket Display Stand
body_html:
Take your rocket presentation to the next level with the Premier Rocket Display Stand. Designed for Premium 29mm Rockets

Built specifically for rockets that fly using 29mm engines, this stand offers a perfect fit that holds your model upright and stable. It is a must-have for collectors who appreciate detail, precision, and presentation. The Premier Rocket Display Stand does not just hold your rocket, it elevates it.

Showcase Your Soyuz

Pair this stand with your Estes Soyuz for a truly professional display. The combination of the Soyuz’s historical design and the stand’s contemporary aesthetic makes for a stunning showcase piece that commands attention from every angle.

Built to Impress

Every detail of the Premier Rocket Display Stand was designed with presentation in mind.
