Whether you are a seasoned collector or displaying your latest masterpiece, this stand ensures your model gets the recognition it deserves.

title: Pro Series II™ Soyuz
body_html:
The Estes Pro Series II™ Soyuz is a masterclass in precision design and craftsmanship. From the moment you open the collector’s edition box, every component speaks to the heritage of excellence that defines this kit. Each part is engineered with meticulous detail, allowing you to recreate one of the most iconic rockets in aerospace history.

This 1:48 scale model captures the true proportions and structural integrity of the real Soyuz, delivering an unmatched combination of realism and performance. The precision-molded components fit seamlessly together, while the design remains faithful to the original spacecraft that carried generations of astronauts to orbit.

Whether you’re a scale model enthusiast or a passionate flyer, the Soyuz offers the best of both worlds. It’s a high-fidelity replica worthy of display, yet fully capable of taking to the skies in authentic, mid-power flight. Every launch feels like witnessing a moment of real-world history lift off your own launch pad.

Authentic Scale Detail

The Soyuz is brought to life with intricately molded boosters, historically accurate decals, and premium paint details that honor the real vehicle. Even the packaging has been designed as a collector’s edition box, perfect for builders and collectors who want to showcase this remarkable kit.

Included Estes Data Pack

Every Pro Series II™ Soyuz purchase includes the Estes Data Pack, a beautifully designed digital companion that can be downloaded after purchase. This stunning PDF takes you deep into the history and heritage of the real Soyuz rocket, covering its Cold War origins, legendary missions, and evolution into one of the most flown boosters in spaceflight history.

Filled with high-resolution imagery, detailed diagrams, and expert commentary, the Data Pack also features advanced building tips to help you achieve a flawless, museum-quality finish. Whether you’re interested in the engineering behind the Soyuz or want insider guidance for your build, this downloadable resource brings the full story of this legendary rocket to life.

Performance Meets History

While it displays beautifully, the Soyuz is engineered to fly. Powered by Pro Series II™ mid-power engines, it can soar up to 500 feet and recovers smoothly using its dual Rip Stop parachutes. This careful balance of form and function ensures that your Soyuz looks as impressive on the ground as it does in the sky.

A Designer’s Dream Realized

Kit designer John Boren shares his decades-long passion for Russian spaceflight, tracing his inspiration back to a childhood library book and culminating in this kit’s final creation. His attention to detail and commitment to performance shine through, making this one of the most significant Estes releases in recent years.

What You’ll Need

To complete your build, you’ll need basic hobby tools including a pencil, scissors, hobby knife, sandpaper, ruler, masking tape, and a variety of adhesives (yellow glue, epoxy, plastic cement, CA glue). For finishing, you’ll need primer, paint, and optional clear coat. For flight, prepare your Soyuz with recovery wadding, a Pro Series II™ launch pad, and an F15-2 or F15-4 engine for a smooth, powerful ascent.

Bring a legendary piece of space history to your collection and your launch pad. The Estes Pro Series II™ Soyuz is more than a model rocket; it’s a tribute to human exploration and engineering excellence. Building the Soyuz is just the beginning; the real magic is watching it take flight for the first time.

Learn More About the Story Behind the Soyuz

Watch the official Soyuz announcement video to explore the history behind this legendary rocket and hear directly from designer John Boren about the inspiration and craftsmanship that brought this model to life.

title: Mega Der Red Max™ UV Vinyl Decal Set
body_html:
The Mega Der Red Max™ UV Vinyl Decal Set is your ticket to restoring one of Estes’ most recognizable rockets to its original glory. This complete four-sheet collection includes every authentic marking found in the Pro Series II™ Mega Der Red Max™ kit, from the iconic skull-and-crossbones to the bold “Top Secret” insignias and classic Estes emblems.

Premium Quality Printing

Each decal is printed on durable vinyl that resists fading, cracking, and peeling over time. The glossy finish brings out sharp contrast and crisp detail, making your Mega Max look just as good on display as it does on the launch pad. The strong adhesive backing ensures each decal stays securely in place through multiple flights.

Complete Replacement Set

This set includes four individual 4 x 16 inch sheets, providing every piece needed to match the factory look of the original kit. Whether your original decals have worn with age or you’re refreshing your build with new paint, this decal set gives your rocket a flawless, like-new appearance.

Authentic Red Max Attitude

From the grinning skulls to the playful military-inspired graphics, the Mega Der Red Max™ has always been about style and personality. These decals capture that same fearless character, letting your rocket stand out on the launch field or in your display collection.

Easy to Apply

Each decal sheet is cut and sized for precise placement on your rocket’s body tube and fins. Simply peel, position, and smooth the decal for a professional finish that matches the original Estes build instructions. No cutting, trimming, or guesswork required.

title: National Association of Rocketry Lapel Pin
body_html:
The National Association of Rocketry Lapel Pin is a classic emblem for every model rocketeer who takes pride in their craft. Showcase Your Commitment

Whether pinned to your launch jacket, displayed on your lanyard, or added to your collection board, this accessory adds a touch of credibility and pride to your rocketry presentation. Its compact size ensures a clean, polished look that stands out without being flashy.

Perfect for Members and Mentors

title: Space Corps™ Centurion™ Launch Set
body_html:
After nearly two years away from the launch pad, the Space Corps™ Centurion™ is back and ready for action. This returning favorite brings the excitement of a space defense mission right to your backyard. Fully assembled and flight ready, the Centurion™ Launch Set captures the essence of classic science fiction adventure without any building required. Now is your chance to rejoin the fleet and relive the thrill of space defense.

With its bold design and rich backstory, this model rocket celebrates the spirit of imagination and exploration that made Space Corps a fan favorite. Whether you are flying solo or sharing the experience with family, each countdown brings the excitement of a full-scale launch within reach.

The Legend of Project Centurion

Project Centurion was born from the Space Corps’ urgent need to counter an unknown presence in our solar system. Six years ago, an alien craft was detected beyond the Asteroid Belt. Its sudden disappearance left more questions than answers, and the Space Corps responded by commissioning the Centurion interceptor. Crafted by the finest engineers of Earth and its colonies, the Centurion became humanity’s first line of defense against the unknown.

The Estes Space Corps Centurion™ is your personal replica of that legendary craft, designed to bring the story to life through flight. Every launch is a mission, and every recovery is a victory for humankind. Prepare to step into the role of Space Corps pilot and take your place among the defenders of Earth.

Performance Meets Adventure

The Centurion™ stands 11.1 inches tall and weighs just 1.4 ounces, making it quick to assemble and easy to launch. It can soar up to 700 feet on a C6-5 engine, descending safely beneath a bright 9-inch parachute. Its aerodynamic body and authentic detailing make it as striking on display as it is in the air. You will enjoy reliable performance and smooth recovery flight after flight, thanks to Estes engineering excellence.

Paired with the included Porta-Pad® II Launch Pad and Electron Beam® Launch Controller, the Centurion™ offers an out-of-the-box experience that is perfect for anyone eager to start flying. Just add your choice of recommended engines and recovery wadding, and you are ready to take off.

What You Will Need

For flight, you will need Estes model rocket engines (A8-3, B4-4, B6-4, B6-6, C6-5, or C6-7), recovery wadding, and a clear launch area. Adult supervision is recommended for rocketeers under 12. With a bit of preparation, you will be ready to witness your Centurion™ soar skyward on its next mission of exploration and defense.

Mission Ready

The Space Corps™ Centurion™ Launch Set is more than a model rocket. It is a story, a symbol, and a ticket back into the thrilling world of Estes space adventures. Whether you are launching for the first time or reigniting your passion after a long hiatus, this classic set brings timeless excitement back to the field. Reclaim your call sign and prepare for liftoff, the Space Corps needs you.

title: PocketLab® Voyager Sensor
body_html:
The PocketLab® Voyager Sensor brings advanced science tools right to your fingertips. Designed for curious experimenters and dedicated learners, this device allows you to explore a wide range of scientific principles in real time. With 10 precision sensors built into one compact unit, you can collect data on acceleration, angular velocity, magnetic fields, light, humidity, and more without bulky lab equipment. The sensor measures 1.5 x 1.5 x 0.6 in (3.8 x 3.8 x 1.5 cm) and weighs only 0.6 oz (17 g), making it small enough to fit easily in your rocket’s payload section.

3D Printed Sled File Included

After purchase, you will receive an emailed link to download a 3D print file for an optional Voyager sensor sled. The sled is designed to hold your sensor securely inside your rocket’s payload section, helping prevent movement or impact damage during flight. The sled itself is not included with the product but can be printed using any standard 3D printer. The design fits BT-65 body tubes, making it compatible with rockets such as the Green Eggs, Mayhem, and Orbitron.

If you prefer not to use the sled, simply secure the sensor in your payload section using foam, wadding, or another suitable material to keep it stable during flight.

Data Collection and Connectivity

Stream data in real time to your smartphone, tablet, or computer during short-range experiments within Bluetooth range (approximately 30 to 100 feet). For rocket launches or tests that exceed Bluetooth distance, data is automatically stored to the onboard memory and can be downloaded later in PocketLab Notebook for analysis, graphing, and comparison.

Built to Go Anywhere

Compact, durable, and rechargeable, Voyager fits in the palm of your hand and travels easily from the classroom to the launch field. With up to 8 hours of battery life per charge and a protective storage case included, you can take your experiments anywhere without missing a beat.

What's Included

  • PocketLab Voyager Sensor
  • Temperature Probe
  • USB Charging Cable
  • Protective Storage Case
  • 3D Print File for Optional Sensor Sled (delivered via email after purchase)

What Does the PocketLab Voyager Sensor Measure?

  • Acceleration
  • Angular Velocity
  • Magnetic Field
  • Position (Rangefinder)
  • Velocity (Rangefinder)
  • Temperature (Probe and Ambient)
  • Barometric Pressure
  • Altitude
  • Light Intensity
  • Humidity
  • Dew Point
  • Heat Index

title: Cherokee-E™
body_html:
The Estes Cherokee-E™ brings back one of the most iconic rockets in model rocketry history, updated with modern engineering for today’s flyers. Its long, streamlined body and bold design make it stand out on the launch pad, while its performance in the air guarantees an unforgettable flight experience.

Powerful Flights up to 1,600 Feet

Get ready to watch your rocket soar skyward! When powered with Estes D12 or E12 engines, the Cherokee-E™ reaches staggering altitudes of up to 1,600 feet (488 m). With its reliable 18-inch parachute recovery system, you’ll enjoy spectacular launches again and again.

Skill-Building Rocket Kit

This kit is designed to give you the full building experience, from cutting and sanding to assembling and finishing. Featuring precision laser-cut balsa fins, the Cherokee-E™ challenges you to refine your craftsmanship while rewarding you with a strong, high-flying model that’s built to last.

Fun for Beginners and Experienced Flyers

Whether you’re new to Estes kits or a longtime hobbyist, the Cherokee-E™ is designed to engage and excite. Beginners will enjoy the approachable build process, while advanced modelers will appreciate the rocket’s sleek aesthetic and powerful flights on larger engines.

title: Pathfinder™ Launch Set

There is no better way to begin your journey into model rocketry than with the Pathfinder™ Launch Set. Each one features colorful graphics, durable construction, and smooth parachute recovery that deliver high-flying fun again and again.

Ready for the Launch Pad

High Flights and Soft Landings

title: Hyper Bat™
body_html:
The Estes Hyper Bat isn’t just another rocket; it’s an adrenaline-packed, two-stage flyer built to push your launches higher than ever before. Designed for rocketeers ready to take the next step, this intermediate-level rocket combines bold performance with unforgettable visual flair. With the ability to soar to an incredible 2,125 feet, the Hyper Bat™ will make every countdown feel like a leap into the unknown.

Striking Design That Stands Out

What makes the Hyper Bat instantly recognizable are its dramatic bat wing-shaped fins and bold black finish accented with crisp white decals. On the launch pad, it looks fierce and ready to strike. In the air, its sleek profile slices cleanly through the sky. Whether flying single stage or powering through with a booster, the Hyper Bat™ looks as good as it performs.

Powerful Two-Stage Performance

The Hyper Bat is built for altitude seekers. Fly it single-stage on B and C engines for quick, high flights, or push it to the max with a booster stage and upper stage combination. With recommended engine setups ranging from A8-0/B6-0/C6-0 boosters to A8-5/B6-6/C6-7 upper stages, you’ll unlock flights that climb to heart-pounding heights and deliver smooth parachute recoveries.

Quality Build and Reliable Recovery

At 21.9 inches tall with a body diameter of 0.98 inches, the Hyper Bat balances sleek lines with sturdy construction. Laser cut balsa wood fins ensure lightweight durability, while the included 12-inch parachute recovery system brings your rocket safely back to Earth. With a finished weight of just 1.8 ounces, it’s lightweight yet tough enough to handle repeated launches.

What You’ll Need

Some assembly is required, making this rocket a rewarding project for hobbyists ages 10 and up (adult supervision under 12). To complete your build, you’ll need basic supplies such as scissors, glue, sandpaper, masking tape, and paint for finishing. For launch day, grab your Porta-Pad® II Launch Pad, Electron Beam® Launch Controller, Estes recovery wadding, and your choice of recommended engines. Then, prepare for the thrill of launching a rocket that looks as fierce as it flies.

title: Pro Series II™ Lil' Spite™
body_html:
The Estes Pro Series II™ Lil’ Spite™ is more than just another rocket, it’s a work of engineering artistry. Developed in collaboration with engineer and YouTube star Xyla Foxlin, Lil’ Spite brings her original high-power design into the hands of hobbyists everywhere. This mid-power rocket blends precision engineering with bold styling, giving you a model that’s as exciting to build as it is to fly.

Striking Design Inspired by Spite

At over four feet tall, Lil’ Spite commands attention with its slim 2-inch diameter body and dramatic carbon fiber fin decals. The look is directly inspired by Xyla’s signature rocket build, complete with sleek black styling that emphasizes speed and strength. Laser-cut plywood fins and an 18-inch rip stop parachute complete the build, ensuring both durability and reliable recovery.

Power and Flexibility in Every Flight

Lil’ Spite is designed to be as flexible as it is powerful. Launch it with Estes 29mm black powder engines like the E16-6 or F15-6 to reach impressive altitudes of up to 1200 feet. For rocketeers ready to push further, Lil’ Spite can also handle advanced high-power composite motors. With the right setup, this rocket is capable of soaring past 3000 feet and even qualifies as a Level 1 high-power certification flight through NAR or Tripoli.

What You’ll Need

This intermediate-level kit requires assembly, making it a rewarding project for hobbyists looking to advance their skills. You’ll need common supplies like sandpaper, glue, primer, and paint to bring your Lil’ Spite to life. For launches, pair it with a Pro Series II™ launch system and the recommended engines for an unforgettable experience. Each build reflects both your craftsmanship and the rocket’s high-performance design.

Unleash the Thrill

Whether you’re an experienced enthusiast seeking altitude or a newcomer ready to step into the world of mid-power rocketry, Lil’ Spite delivers. With its combination of sleek looks, proven engineering, and serious performance, this rocket is a standout in the Estes Pro Series II lineup. title: E12-0 Engines
body_html:
The Estes E12-0 is a 24 mm booster-stage rocket engine engineered for dependable, high-thrust performance in two-stage flights. With a peak thrust of 31.3 N (7.0 lbs) and a 2.6 second burn, the E12-0 supplies the surge your second-stage motor needs for clean separation and strong initial climb. Its compact 3.8 inch length and proven propellant formulation make it a favorite for modelers who want repeatable results without complicated setup.

What sets the E12-0 apart is how it balances power and practicality. This engine was designed for straightforward use by hobbyists; it pairs seamlessly with any compatible 24 mm sustainer motor to create satisfying two-stage flights. The combination of predictable thrust curve and no delay (time-delay none) means you get an immediate booster impulse when you need it most, making staging timing simpler to manage and reducing the variables that can complicate multi-stage launches.

Each package contains 2 E12-0 engines, 2 igniters, and 4 igniter plugs so you have the essentials to prepare multiple launches and spare hardware for quick turnaround between flights. The E12-0’s total impulse of 28.80 N·s, propellant weight of 36.9 g, and lightweight construction (2.05 oz / 58.1 g per engine) are optimized for rockets that weigh less than 16.0 oz (454 g) including engines, the ideal choice for many 24 mm two-stage kits and custom builds.

Whether you’re rounding out a weekend of flying with friends or dialing in staging performance for your competition model, the E12-0 is an easy, dependable way to add a true booster stage to your rockets. Always follow Estes safety guidelines and the motor instructions printed on the package; proper engine installation, launch system compatibility, and field safety practices are essential for safe, repeatable flights.

title: PNC-60RL Nose Cone
body_html:
The PNC-60RL Nose Cone is designed to deliver both strength and aerodynamic efficiency to your BT-60 rockets. Its conical shape minimizes drag during ascent, helping rockets like the Hi-Flier XL, Vapor, Antar, and Star Orbiter reach their full altitude potential.

Crafted from injection-molded ABS plastic, the PNC-60RL offers exceptional durability while remaining lightweight enough to maximize lift. This material resists cracking, warping, and environmental wear, ensuring reliable use across many flights.

Engineered for compatibility with BT-60 body tubes, it includes a molded eyelet that makes shock cord and parachute attachment simple and secure. Its modular design makes it easy to replace or upgrade components in your rocket builds.

Trusted in popular Estes kits, this nose cone provides a proven combination of durability, aerodynamic performance, and ease of use. Whether you’re building from scratch or replacing a worn part, the PNC-60RL is a reliable solution for your next launch.

title: PNC-60AH Nose Cone
body_html:
The PNC-60AH Nose Cone is engineered for rocketeers who want both strength and aerodynamic performance in their builds. Its sleek conical shape minimizes air resistance during ascent, helping rockets fly straighter and higher with improved stability from launch through recovery.

Crafted from blow-molded high-impact polystyrene (HIPS), this nose cone is both strong and lightweight. The material resists cracking, deformation, and environmental wear, making it a reliable choice for repeated launches in various flying conditions.

Designed for compatibility, the PNC-60AH fits seamlessly into BT-60 body tubes. Its molded eyelet provides a secure anchor point for shock cords and parachutes, simplifying recovery system integration and ensuring dependable deployment at apogee.

Featured in legendary kits like the Der Red Max and Citation Patriot, this nose cone has a proven history of performance and reliability. Whether replacing a part or building a custom design, the PNC-60AH is a versatile upgrade for your rocketry collection.

title: Mercury Redstone Capsule Plastic Parts
body_html:
The Mercury Redstone Capsule Nose Cone is an essential component for accurate scale model rocketry. Modeled after the historic Mercury spacecraft, this capsule adds a distinctive, realistic profile to your rocket while also serving as a functional aerodynamic nose cone.

Crafted from high-quality molded plastic, the capsule is lightweight yet durable, resisting wear from repeated launches. Its smooth finish makes it easy to paint and detail, allowing you to replicate the authentic Mercury capsule design or create your own unique style.

Engineered for compatibility, this replacement nose cone fits seamlessly into BT-20 body tubes. Whether you are restoring a vintage Mercury Redstone or Little Joe I kit, or building a custom scale rocket, this part ensures a secure fit and stable flight performance.

A trusted choice for scale enthusiasts and hobbyists, the Mercury Redstone Capsule Nose Cone combines historical accuracy with dependable function, making it a standout addition to your fleet.

title: PNC-55AC Nose Cone
body_html:
The PNC-55AC Nose Cone is designed to balance strength, lightweight performance, and aerodynamic efficiency for BT-55 body tube rockets. Blow-molded from high-impact polystyrene (HIPS), it provides the ideal combination of durability and low mass to maximize altitude potential while ensuring dependable recovery system deployment.

Its seamless, smooth surface reduces drag and maintains a clean aerodynamic profile, whether conical or ogive in shape. This ensures straighter trajectories, improved stability, and reduced air resistance—helping your rocket perform at its best from launch to recovery.

Engineered for compatibility, the PNC-55AC includes a molded shoulder for a snug, secure fit inside BT-55 tubes. The built-in eyelet simplifies attachment of parachutes or shock cords, making recovery setup quick and reliable.

Used in well-regarded Estes kits such as the Cherokee E, Bull Pup 12D, Nike-X, and the Designer’s Special, this versatile nose cone offers both professional finish and dependable flight performance for new builds or replacement parts.

title: NC-20A Nose Cone Insert
body_html:
The NC-20A Nose Cone Insert plays a critical role in the performance and reliability of your model rocket. Installed at the base of the nose cone, it functions as a retention pin that secures the cone in place during boost while allowing controlled separation at apogee.

Engineered from injection-molded ABS, the insert offers a durable yet slightly flexible structure that resists breakage under launch stresses. This design ensures the nose cone ejects cleanly without premature release or excessive friction.

Sized to fit BT-20 body tubes, the NC-20A Insert delivers precise engagement and alignment with the rocket’s shoulder. Modelers can lightly sand the insert or tube interior if adjustments are needed for an optimal fit.

Trusted in rockets like the Ripley, Trail-Blazer Trio, and AVG Bulk Pack, the NC-20A Nose Cone Insert provides consistent performance, making it a must-have replacement part for your fleet.

title: PNC-20A Nose Cone
body_html:
The PNC-20A Nose Cone is a proven component for modelers looking to maximize aerodynamic efficiency. Its conical design helps reduce drag, promoting straighter trajectories and improved stability from liftoff to recovery.

Constructed from injection-molded ABS plastic, this nose cone combines lightweight performance with exceptional toughness. The material resists cracking, warping, and UV damage, ensuring it can withstand many launches without compromise.

Engineered to fit BT-20 body tubes, the PNC-20A is designed to be used with the NC-20A Nose Cone Insert. The insert provides a secure anchor and controlled separation at ejection while keeping assembly straightforward and dependable.

Trusted in Estes kits such as the Ripley, Wizard, Viking, Hi-Flier, Mini Arcas, Sidekick, and AVG Bulk Pack, the PNC-20A delivers reliable performance across some of the most popular rocket builds.

title: PNC-60 Nose Cone
body_html:

Made from blow-molded HIPS plastic, this nose cone combines strength and lightness. The material resists cracking, impact stress, and environmental wear, making it an excellent choice for consistent, high-performance flights.

Built to fit BT-60 body tubes, the PNC-60 offers a precise fit that ensures easy assembly and secure placement. The molded eyelet at the base provides a convenient connection point for parachutes or streamers.

Featured in classic Estes kits like the Big Bertha, this versatile nose cone is ideal for both kit replacements and custom rocket builds.

title: NC-5A Nose Cone Insert
body_html:

Designed to act as the retention pin, it locks the nose cone securely in place during ascent while ensuring clean, controlled separation at ejection. This reliable fit prevents premature release yet guarantees the nose cone ejects smoothly at apogee when the recovery system activates.

Made from injection-molded ABS plastic, the NC-5A Insert delivers durability with a touch of flexibility. This combination helps reduce the risk of breakage under launch and recovery stresses, while also making it easy to reuse across multiple flights. Its molded eyelet provides a strong anchor point for shock cords, parachutes, or streamers.

Engineered for precision, the insert matches the internal diameter of BT-5 body tubes. Builders can also fine-tune the fit by lightly sanding the insert or tube shoulder if needed, ensuring consistent engagement and alignment every time.

Though not currently part of an active Estes kit, the NC-5A Nose Cone Insert is an essential accessory for custom builds using the PNC-5A Nose Cone. Together, they form a dependable nose cone assembly that supports stable, high-performance flights and safe recoveries.

title: PNC-5A Nose Cone
body_html:

This nose cone is designed for use with the NC-5A Insert (sold separately). The insert provides a snug, secure fit into BT-5 body tubes and includes the attachment point for shock cords or parachutes, ensuring reliable recovery after every launch.

title: BT-55 Shock Cord Anchors (6 pk)
body_html:
Say goodbye to fiddly paper shock cord mounts and hello to a cleaner, stronger, and more reliable alternative. Estes BT-55 Shock Cord Anchors are purpose-built for rockets that use BT-55 body tubes, offering a durable and hassle-free upgrade. Whether you're new to the hobby or refining your build process, these anchors streamline recovery system setup like never before.

Built-In 3M Adhesive for Quick Installation

Installation is a breeze thanks to the pre-applied 3M adhesive backing. Just peel off the liner, press the anchor into place inside the body tube (below the nose cone line), and you're ready for shock cord attachment. No glue, no mess, just fast, secure mounting every time.

Dependable Tie-Off, Flight After Flight

Each anchor is crafted from injection-molded ABS for maximum durability and features a smart threading slot to securely tie off your shock cord. The wrap-and-loop method keeps your recovery system firmly attached, even through repeated ejection charges and flights. It's a small upgrade that makes a big difference in flight confidence.

Six Anchors Per Pack

Each pack includes 6 BT-55 Shock Cord Anchors, plenty for multiple builds, classroom settings, or repair kits. Whether you're building rockets for fun, education, or competition, these anchors ensure a professional, no-fuss finish every time.

title: BT-50 Shock Cord Anchors (6 pk)
body_html:
Ditch the paper shock cord mounts and make the switch to a cleaner, stronger solution. The Estes BT-50 Shock Cord Anchors are designed specifically for kits that use BT-50 body tubes and are ideal for beginner and intermediate builders. Crafted from durable injection-molded ABS, these anchors simplify the assembly process and improve long-term performance for your model rockets.

Fast Installation with Built-In Adhesive

Each anchor features a pre-applied strip of 3M adhesive, eliminating the need for messy glues or drying time. Simply peel, press, and go. Placement is easy, just slide the anchor inside the body tube far enough to clear the nose cone. These anchors ensure a reliable hold without the hassle, making them perfect for classrooms, clubs, or solo builds.

Designed for Reliability and Repeat Use

The strong ABS construction holds up under repeated ejection charge forces and keeps your recovery system securely attached flight after flight. The innovative thread-through-and-wrap tie-off method locks the cord in place with a tight knot, reducing the risk of pullout. If you’ve ever had a paper mount fail mid-flight, you’ll appreciate the extra confidence these give.

Pack of Six for Multiple Builds

Each pack includes six BT-50 Shock Cord Anchors, enough for multiple rockets or a series of test builds. Whether you're prototyping a new design or upgrading your go-to kit, these anchors streamline your workflow and improve the reliability of your builds.

title: BT-60 Shock Cord Anchors (6 pk)
body_html:
Upgrade your rocket recovery system with Estes BT-60 Shock Cord Anchors, the smart replacement for old-fashioned paper mounts. Specifically designed for rockets with BT-60 body tubes, these anchors are ideal for beginner and intermediate builders who want a faster, cleaner, and more secure way to install shock cords.

Peel, Press, and You’re Done

Each anchor includes a pre-applied strip of strong 3M adhesive, eliminating the need for glue or drying time. Just peel off the backing and press the anchor into place inside the body tube—far enough to clear the nose cone. It’s the simplest way to get your rocket ready for flight with professional-grade reliability.

Durable ABS Design and Foolproof Tie-Off

Crafted from injection-molded ABS plastic, these anchors hold up to repeated flight stresses and ejection charges. The built-in threading slot allows for a tight, secure knot that keeps your shock cord firmly in place throughout your rocket’s flight cycle. It's one less thing to worry about on launch day.

Pack of Six for Your Fleet

Each pack contains 6 BT-60 Shock Cord Anchors, perfect for multiple builds, upgrades, or classroom use. Whether you’re launching for fun or fine-tuning your designs, these anchors ensure consistent, dependable results every time.

title: Assorted Shock Cord Anchors (6 pk)
body_html:
Whether you’re upgrading existing kits or building a diverse rocket fleet, Estes Shock Cord Anchors make it easy to secure your recovery system with confidence. This 6-pack includes two anchors for each of the most common body tube sizes, BT-50, BT-55, and BT-60, so you’re always prepared for your next build.

No Glue Required

Each anchor is pre-fitted with a strong 3M adhesive strip for a quick, no-mess installation. Just peel, press into place inside the appropriate body tube (positioned far enough back to clear the nose cone), and your anchor is ready for shock cord tie-off. It’s an instant upgrade over traditional paper mounts.

Durable, Flight-Tested Design

title: Pro Series II™ Scorpio 3D
body_html:
Push the Boundaries of What a Rocket Can Be

The Pro Series II™ Scorpio 3D is more than a model rocket—it’s your personal design lab. With a unique blend of high-flying performance and total customization, this intermediate-level kit lets you 3D print your own parts and experiment with multiple fin configurations. Whether you’re testing aerodynamic performance or flexing your maker skills, Scorpio 3D gives you the tools to explore rocketry in a whole new way.

Everything You Need—Ready to Print

After purchase, you'll receive access to downloadable 3D print files in both standard and metric units. The printable parts include the nose cone, fin can, body tube coupler, male and female engine retainers, and six distinct tail fin designs. Print them at home using your preferred materials and settings, then get ready to assemble and launch. No special supports are required, and general printer settings are provided to ensure successful prints.

Six Fin Styles. Unlimited Experiments.

The Scorpio 3D’s twist-lock fin can makes it easy to swap fins without tools or adhesives. With six tail fin styles to choose from—or remix and reprint your own—you can explore how different fin shapes impact altitude, stability, and flight behavior. Each launch becomes a chance to test a new theory, compare results, and fine-tune your rocket’s design for your next mission.

Launch Performance Meets Maker Flexibility

This customizable rocket stands 41.5 inches tall, has a 2-inch diameter, and weighs approximately 17 oz. With an included 24-inch ripstop parachute for recovery and support for E16-4 and F15-6 engines, Scorpio 3D can reach up to 1,000 feet. It’s compatible with both 1/4 inch launch rods and 1010 rails, making it an ideal match for the Pro Series II™ Launch Pad or Launch Rail.

What’s Included in the Kit

In addition to the downloadable 3D print files, the Scorpio 3D kit includes all the physical components you need to complete your build: a durable body tube, engine mount tube, aramid cord, shock cord, a 24-inch ripstop parachute for recovery, and a set of water slide decals for finishing. These components pair with your printed parts to create a high-performance, fully functional model rocket ready for flight.

Recommended 3D Print Settings

To get the best performance from your printed components, we recommend the following settings: PLA+, PETG, or ABS filaments; no supports required (optional at your discretion); wall thickness of 3 lines with a 0.4 mm nozzle; 7% infill (gyroid); and a 3 mm or wider brim for strong bed adhesion. Once printed, your parts are ready to assemble, fly, and experiment—again and again.

3D Printer Size Requirements

To print the nose cone in a single piece, your 3D printer must have a build height of at least 260 mm. If your printer doesn’t meet this requirement, the nose cone can still be printed in multiple sections and glued together. This alternative method works well but does require a bit more precision and model-building experience to ensure a clean final result.

title: D12-0 Engines
body_html:
The Estes D12-0 is a booster-stage model rocket engine designed to provide powerful thrust for multi-stage rocket launches. Measuring 2.75 inches (7 cm) in length and 24 mm in diameter, this engine is compatible with a wide range of rocket designs. Each package includes two engines, two starters, and four starter plugs, ensuring you have the essentials for multiple launch sequences.

With a total impulse of 20.00 Newton-seconds and a thrust duration of approximately 1.6 seconds, the D12-0 delivers robust performance to propel rockets weighing up to 14 ounces (396 grams) during the initial boost phase. It's important to note that this engine features no time delay or ejection charge, making it specifically suited for the booster stage in multi-stage rockets.

The D12-0 engine achieves a maximum thrust of 32.90 Newtons (7.4 pounds), providing the necessary power to launch heavier rockets effectively. Its design ensures a consistent and reliable thrust profile, which is crucial for achieving desired altitudes and stable flight trajectories.

Safety and compliance are paramount with Estes products. The D12-0 engine adheres to National Association of Rocketry (NAR) standards, ensuring a secure and enjoyable launch experience. Always follow the recommended guidelines and use appropriate launch systems and recovery wadding to maintain safe operation. With the D12-0 engine, prepare for thrilling flights and successful missions in your model rocketry endeavors.

title: F15-8 Engines (29 mm)
body_html:

title: Kerbal Rocket & Jeb
body_html:
Introducing the Kerbal Rocket & Jeb

Step into the world of space exploration with the Kerbal Rocket & Jeb, an Estes model rocket kit that brings the wildly popular Kerbal Space Program video game into the real world! Perfect for fans of space and model rockets alike, this kit captures the thrilling adventures of Kerbal Space Program's fearless, green astronaut, Jebediah "Jeb" Kerman. With over 4.3 million copies sold, Kerbal Space Program has captured hearts worldwide by simulating the challenges and excitement of space exploration with a unique blend of humor and realism! Now, you can bring a part of that excitement to life with this collectible, launchable model rocket!

Meet Jeb Kerman: The Bold, Green Astronaut

Jeb Kerman is one of the most beloved characters in Kerbal Space Program, celebrated for his fearless, adventure-loving spirit. No matter how risky the mission or daunting the challenge, Jeb is always the first to jump into the pilot’s seat with his trademark grin. While other Kerbals might look nervous as they rocket into the unknown, Jeb’s calm confidence shines through, making him the perfect mascot for Kerbal Space Program’s mix of science, humor, and thrilling discovery. He’s the ultimate space daredevil, ready to explore planets, moons, and beyond!

A Fun, Easy-to-Build Rocket Kit

The Kerbal Rocket & Jeb is designed for an Intermediate skill level and features a snap-together model rocket inspired by Jeb’s adventures in the game. The kit also includes a collectible Jeb figurine, bringing the fearless Kerbal character right to your launchpad! With bright decals and simple instructions, this kit makes for an enjoyable build experience that will appeal to Kerbal Space Program fans of all ages!

Take Jeb on His Next Epic Journey

Once assembled, this rocket is ready to launch on its next great adventure. Using the recommended Porta-Pad II launch pad, you can send your Kerbal Rocket up to 375 feet in the air! The rocket is equipped with a 15-inch parachute recovery system, ensuring a smooth and safe descent and allowing you to reuse the rocket for more thrilling flights!

Bring the Kerbal Universe to Life

With vibrant packaging, an eye-catching display box, and fun details inspired by Kerbal Space Program, the Kerbal Rocket & Jeb is as fun to showcase as it is to fly! Whether you're a fan of model rockets, space exploration, or the goofy yet determined Kerbals, this rocket kit offers a unique, playful experience that connects you to the Kerbal Space Program universe in a whole new way! Get ready to launch, learn, and laugh with Jeb as he takes to the skies right from your backyard!

With a 6-second delay between burnout and recovery deployment, the F15-6 is tailored for mid-size rockets that benefit from longer coast phases. This extended delay allows rockets to climb to higher altitudes before the ejection charge activates, maximizing performance in rockets with slightly heavier payloads or larger airframes. The 3.45-second burn time provides a smooth and powerful push, enhancing flight dynamics and altitude potential.

At 4.5 inches in length and weighing just 3.66 ounces, this engine fits rockets that use 29 mm engine mounts and is especially useful for flights where precise timing and altitude gains are important. It’s a reliable choice for rockets requiring a balance between thrust power and delay timing. The propellant weight of 2.12 ounces ensures you get a high-energy burn for exciting liftoffs and a thrilling flight experience every time.

Whether you’re launching for fun, altitude, or testing your rocketry design skills, the F15-6 delivers a dependable and rewarding launch experience. Pair it with your favorite Estes rocket that calls for an F-engine and enjoy the confidence that comes with top-tier performance and long burn capability.

title: Pro Series II™ Athena H
body_html:
Discover the Legacy of Ballistic Reentry Vehicles (ABRES) with the Athena H Pro Series II Model Rocket!

Unleash the thrill of expert-level rocketry with the Athena H Pro Series II rocket! Modeled after the historic Athena H #3, this advanced kit invites rocketeers to embark on a challenging and rewarding build, capturing the essence of one of history's iconic reentry sounding rockets. Perfect for those looking to push their skills to the limit, the Athena H combines historical significance, precision engineering, and an unforgettable launch experience.

Performance-Packed Rocketry

Powered by 29mm Estes engines, the Athena H is designed to soar to a dazzling altitude of 1,200 feet! Whether you're an experienced rocketeer seeking a new challenge or aiming to replicate the flight of the original Athena H, this model promises high-adrenaline fun with every launch!

Historical Significance Meets Modern Engineering

The Athena H was first launched in April 1971 as part of a series of NASA sounding rockets designed for ballistic reentry testing. This model faithfully replicates the details of Athena H #3, including the distinctive clover decal, commemorating its St. Patrick's Day launch. With a history that includes launches from Green River, Utah, and Wake Island during the Army's HAVE MILL program, the Athena H's legacy is now at your fingertips, ready to be revived with each launch.

Impressive Design and Scale

Standing at an impressive 33.75 inches tall and boasting a 2.2-inch diameter, the Athena H Pro Series II is a 1:18 scale model that pays homage to the original rocket. From the sleek design to the intricate waterslide decals, every detail has been carefully crafted to reflect the history and precision of the Athena H program. This rocket is not just a marvel in flight but also a stunning display piece in any collection, showcasing both form and function.

Reliable Recovery System

Every launch of the Athena H ends with a smooth and controlled descent, thanks to the robust 24" nylon parachute recovery system. This ensures that your rocket returns safely, allowing you to relaunch and experience the thrill of high-powered rocketry over and over again. Protect your investment and enjoy the satisfaction of seeing your expertly built rocket soar and return intact!

A Build for the True Expert

With its complex assembly and attention to historical accuracy, the Athena H Pro Series II is designed for expert-level rocketeers. The build offers a rewarding experience for those looking to advance their skills, ensuring each component is meticulously crafted for precision and durability. The challenge is as satisfying as the launch, making this kit a must-have for experienced builders.

Embrace History and Push the Limits of Rocketry

Elevate your rocketry adventures with the Athena H Pro Series II! As a tribute to the groundbreaking reentry tests of the 1970s, this model offers both an exhilarating launch experience and a connection to the history of space exploration. With every flight, you'll relive the excitement of pioneering science and engineering while pushing the boundaries of your own rocketry achievements.

After a powerful ascent, the Nike Smoke deploys a large 24 inch parachute for a controlled and gentle descent. This recovery system helps protect your rocket on landing and makes it easy to prep for repeat flights, so you can spend more time launching and less time worrying about recovery.

Classic Nike Smoke Styling

Inspired by the iconic Nike Smoke sounding rocket, this 1:5.5 scale model features a sleek profile that looks incredible on the launch pad and in flight. The bold design and clean lines make it a standout addition to any rocketeer’s collection, whether displayed on a shelf or soaring through the sky.

A Rewarding Build for Advancing Rocketeers

The Pro Series II Nike Smoke offers a satisfying construction experience that helps builders sharpen their skills. With larger components and durable molded plastic fins, this kit delivers a solid, confidence-inspiring build that prepares you for future mid-powered projects while still being approachable for motivated intermediate hobbyists.

Take the Next Step in Your Rocketry Journey

If you are ready to experience bigger rockets, stronger engines, and more dramatic launches, the Pro Series II Nike Smoke is the perfect next step. Designed to deliver consistent performance and unforgettable flights, this model rocket turns every launch into a milestone moment in your rocketry journey.

title: Mini Der Red Max™
body_html:

Perfect for Intermediate Rocket Enthusiasts

Impressive Altitude with Mini Engines

When paired with an A10-3T engine, the Mini Der Red Max can reach altitudes up to 300 feet. Despite its compact size, this rocket packs a powerful punch, soaring to impressive heights and providing a one-of-a-kind flight experience!

Streamer Recovery System

Equipped with a streamer recovery system, your Mini Der Red Max will descend back to Earth after each launch with ease and reliability. This feature ensures a smooth return, allowing you to launch again and again.

Inspired by the Iconic Der Big Red Max

Inspired by the iconic Estes Der Big Red Max, this mini version preserves all the charm and excitement of its predecessor while offering a more manageable size for enthusiasts who prefer smaller rockets. Whether you're a seasoned rocketeer looking for a new challenge or a beginner ready to step up your game, the Estes Mini Der Red Max is sure to provide a great time!

Experience the Thrill Today

Experience the excitement of rocketry with the Estes Mini Der Red Max. Whether you're launching solo or with friends, this miniature rocket promises big thrills and unforgettable experiences Get ready to soar to new heights and embark on countless adventures with the Mini Der Red Max!

title: Big Bertha®
body_html:
Big Bertha® does not rush the experience. Her slow, realistic liftoff gives you time to hear the engine roar, watch the rocket rise, and feel the excitement build as she climbs higher and higher. It is the kind of launch that draws cheers, cameras, and wide eyes every single time.

Big Presence on the Pad and in the Sky

With her larger size and unmistakable silhouette, Big Bertha commands attention before launch and keeps it long after liftoff. Powered by standard Estes engines, she can soar up to 500 feet while remaining smooth and stable, creating a flight you can actually follow from start to finish.

The Perfect Ending to Every Flight

Just when you think the show is over, Big Bertha delivers one more highlight. The bright 18 inch parachute blossoms high above the field, slowing her descent and giving you plenty of time to track her landing. It is a satisfying, graceful return that makes recovery part of the fun.

Built With Care and Meant to Be Flown

Big Bertha is crafted from quality Estes body tubes, laser cut balsa wood fins, and a molded plastic nose cone, giving you a build that feels rewarding from the first step to the final decal. Applying the waterslide decals brings the rocket to life, creating a finished model you will be proud to place on the pad.

A Rocket You Will Never Leave at Home

Once Big Bertha earns her first flight, she becomes a permanent part of your launch lineup. This is the rocket you grab when you want a guaranteed great launch, the one that delivers smiles, memories, and that unmistakable feeling of watching something you built soar into the sky.

title: Big Bertha™ T-Shirt
body_html:

This shirt’s classic design and vibrant color honor the rocket that’s been a fan favorite for decades.

Comfort Meets Style

Made with high-quality, breathable fabric, this shirt provides comfort whether you’re launching rockets or just relaxing. Its lightweight construction makes it perfect for all-day wear, and its bold design ensures you’ll stand out wherever you go.

Celebrate an Icon

Big Bertha is more than just a rocket, it’s a symbol of fun, imagination, and the spirit of rocketry. Wearing this shirt connects you to the excitement of countless launches and the enduring legacy of Estes Rockets. It’s the ultimate way to share your passion with the world.

A Must-Have for Enthusiasts

Whether you’re a longtime rocketeer or just beginning your journey, the Big Bertha™ T-Shirt makes a perfect addition to your wardrobe or collection. Pair it with your favorite launch gear, wear it at events, or gift it to a fellow rocketry fan, it’s a shirt that celebrates a true classic.

title: Mini Bertha™
body_html:

Soaring to New Heights

Streamer Recovery System

Bold Aesthetics

Ignite Your Passion for Exploration

With a perfect balance of power and aesthetics, this model rocket ensures that the sky is not a limit but a thrilling beginning. Unleash your inner explorer and launch into the extraordinary with the Estes Mini Bertha!

Classic Charm in a Compact Form

Inspired by the timeless Estes Alpha, the Mini Alpha preserves all the charm and excitement of its predecessor in a scaled-down version. Whether you're a newcomer or a seasoned hobbyist, the Estes Mini Alpha promises an unforgettable journey into the thrilling world of model rocketry!

title: Long Ranger™
body_html:
Experience the Thrill of the Estes Long Ranger

Unleash your inner astronaut with the Estes Long Ranger, the epitome of excitement for both budding rocketeers and seasoned enthusiasts! Crafted with precision, this model rocket ensures not just launches, but an experience that will leave you wanting more!

Effortless Assembly for Maximum Launch Time

Say goodbye to tedious construction processes! The Long Ranger is meticulously designed for easy assembly, ensuring that you spend less time building and more time launching. Powered by Precision

Powered by standard model rocket engines, the Long Ranger delivers unparalleled thrust and acceleration, propelling it skyward with breathtaking speed and precision! Flying on an Estes C6-5 engine, the Long Ranger boasts a max altitude of 1100 feet. For those who are wanting to keep it a little closer to Earth, the Long Ranger also flies on smaller A8-3, B4-4, and B6-4 engines. So whether you're launching in your backyard or at a designated rocketry field, the Long Ranger ensures a spectacle that will captivate spectators and leave them in awe!

Soaring Altitudes, Speechless Moments

Experience the exhilaration of liftoff as you watch your Long Ranger soar into the sky, reaching altitudes that defy expectations! And fear not—thanks to its reliable 12-inch parachute recovery system, your rocket will return safely to Earth, ready to embark on yet another adventure!

Ignite Your Passion with the Estes Long Ranger

Join the global community of rocketry enthusiasts and let your imagination take flight with the Estes Long Ranger. Whether you're a newcomer to the world of rocketry or a seasoned veteran, the Long Ranger offers an unparalleled experience that will fuel your passion and push the boundaries of what's possible. With the Long Ranger, the sky is not the limit—it's just the beginning of an extraordinary journey into the realms of imagination and exploration!

title: Mini Arcas
body_html:
The Estes Mini Arcas is designed for hobbyists who enjoy dialing in the details and mastering the nuances of mini engine flight. Lightweight construction, precision components, and a streamlined profile work together to create a rocket that rewards careful building and thoughtful engine selection.

This is a kit that feels purposeful from the first dry fit to the final countdown. Every launch delivers the satisfaction that comes from skill, preparation, and a well executed flight.

Big Altitude from a Compact Design

Powered by 13 mm mini engines, the Mini Arcas is capable of reaching projected altitudes up to 550 feet. Watching this slender rocket leap off the pad and disappear into the sky is a reminder that size does not limit performance.

The Mylar streamer recovery system ensures high visibility during descent while keeping the rocket light and flight ready for repeated launches.

Classic Inspiration with Modern Craftsmanship

Inspired by the iconic Estes Arcas, this miniature version captures the look and spirit of a true rocketry classic. Laser cut balsa fins provide crisp lines and excellent strength, while the overall design honors the heritage that made the original Arcas a standout.

Whether you fly it often or proudly display it alongside your collection, the Mini Arcas delivers nostalgia without sacrificing modern performance.

Built for Builders Who Want More

The Mini Arcas is ideal for experienced hobbyists looking to refine their skills or add a high performance mini engine rocket to their fleet. It is a rewarding build that shines on the launch field and delivers consistent, exciting flights.

If you enjoy rockets that demand attention to detail and reward precision, the Mini Arcas belongs on your next launch day checklist.

Display with Pride

Perfectly sized to fit your favorite frame, the Space Shuttle Poster can be proudly displayed anywhere, whether in a launch workshop, office, or living room. Its clean, bold design ensures it stands out, inspiring you and others to keep looking upward.

title: Power Patrol™
body_html:

The Power Patrol is equipped with a parachute recovery system designed to ensure smooth and safe landings. This feature allows for multiple launches, giving hobbyists the chance to perfect their rocket-building and flying skills. Its durable materials and reliable recovery system make it a long-lasting addition to any rocketeer’s collection.

Whether you're just starting out or looking for a dependable rocket for your next launch day, the Power Patrol is a top-notch choice. Combining ease of use, high performance, and bold aesthetics, it embodies the fun and excitement of model rocketry.

title: 400 Grit Sandpaper (pack of 3)

Essential for Rocket Building

Building rockets isn’t just about assembly, it’s about craftsmanship. The 320 Grit Sandpaper Pack provides the right level of abrasion to refine surfaces without over-sanding. Whether you’re smoothing seams or preparing fins, this pack ensures precision every time.

Perfect for the Sanding Bar

Stock Up for Success

Durability Meets Convenience

Build with Confidence

When it comes to crafting rockets that fly as great as they look, preparation is key. With the 180 Grit Sandpaper Pack, you’ll have the tool you need to take pride in every launch. Elevate your builds, perfect your finishes, and enjoy the satisfaction of launching rockets that look as polished as they perform.

title: 1010 Rail Buttons
body_html:
When it comes to high-power rocketry, precision matters. Estes 1010 Rail Buttons are specifically engineered to provide smooth, stable guidance along the Pro Series Launch Rail. By keeping your rocket aligned from ignition to liftoff, these buttons ensure consistent, reliable performance every time you launch.

Durable and Reliable Construction

Crafted from tough, wear-resistant materials, Estes 1010 Rail Buttons are built to withstand repeated use while maintaining a secure fit. Their rugged design means you can count on them for flight after flight without worrying about premature wear or failure.

Easy Installation, Seamless Performance

With a simple design, these rail buttons are easy to install on your rocket’s airframe. Once mounted, they create a smooth interface with the launch rail, reducing friction and ensuring a clean, controlled departure from the pad.

Perfect for Pro Series Rockets

Designed to pair with the Estes Pro Series Launch Rail, the 1010 Rail Buttons are the ultimate accessory for your advanced builds. Whether you’re prepping for your first Pro Series launch or fine-tuning a veteran favorite, these buttons bring professional-grade stability to your setup.

title: Pro Series II™ Launch Rail System
body_html:
Introducing the Estes Pro Series Launch Rail! This custom-made six-foot-long, two-piece extruded aluminum rail sets a new standard for performance and reliability! This launch rail boasts an all-metal construction with fiberglass reinforced nylon components, providing durability and stability throughout every launch. The rail is compatible with 1010 rail buttons and guides.

Safety First

The stainless-steel blast deflector plate adds a layer of safety and protection, allowing you to push the boundaries of your rocketry adventures with confidence. Launch your rockets knowing that your equipment is built to withstand the rigors of high-speed launches!

Effortless Assembly

Taking just 15 minutes from the box to a flight-ready status, the Pro Series Launch Rail will have you launching in no time! Say goodbye to lengthy setup times and hello to more time spent launching rockets!

Versatility at Your Fingertips

With its innovative design, the rail rotates down effortlessly, allowing for easy loading of your rocket models. Gone are the days of struggling to position your rocket on the launch pad. Its adjustability allows for six different angle locations, providing you with the flexibility to tailor your launch setup to your specific needs.

Effortless Transportation and Storage

Transportation and storage are made effortless with its easy disassembly capability. Simply fold it up in seconds, and you're ready to hit the road. Whether you're heading to a local rocketry club meet-up or venturing out to a remote launch site, the Pro Series Launch Rail is designed to accompany you wherever your rocketry adventures take you!

Elevate Your Experience

Part of the esteemed Pro Series line, the Estes Pro Series Launch Rail is sure to elevate your rocket launching experience to new heights! Launch with confidence and precision with the Estes Pro Series Launch Rail!

Technical Specifications

Rail Length: 6 feet (1.83 meters), composed of two 3-foot (0.91 meters) extruded aluminum sections.
Material: All-metal construction with durable fiberglass-reinforced nylon components for extra strength.
Blast Deflector Plate: 1.5mm thick Stainless steel, designed to protect against exhaust heat and debris.
Adjustable Angles: Six preset launch angles adjustable in one degree increments for custom launch trajectories.
Assembly Time: Quick assembly in approximately 15 minutes.
Portability: Easy to disassemble for transport and storage.
Compatibility: Supports rockets equipped with standard 1010 rail buttons.

Disclaimer: The Estes PS II Launch Rail has been tested for compatibility with current Pro Series II (PS II) rocket kits. Estes will continue to test the launch rail with all future PS II Models. Use of the PS II Launch Rail with non-Estes rockets has not been evaluated by Estes. Users who choose to do so assume full responsibility for assessing suitability and accept all risks and liabilities associated with such use.

title: NASA SLS Hoodie
body_html:
The NASA SLS Hoodie brings the spirit of space exploration into a comfortable, everyday sweatshirt you will reach for again and again. Inspired by NASA’s Space Launch System, this hoodie is perfect for rocket fans, space enthusiasts, and anyone who wants to carry a little launch-day excitement wherever they go.

Built for Comfort, Made for Everyday Wear

Crafted from an 8 oz. 50/50 cotton-polyester blend, the NASA SLS Hoodie offers the softness you want with the durability you need. It is warm enough for cool nights at the launch field, yet comfortable enough for relaxing at home, heading to school, or running weekend errands.

Durable Details That Hold Up

Double-needle stitching at the waistband and cuffs gives this hoodie a sturdy feel that is ready for regular wear. The 1x1 rib knit cuffs and waistband include spandex for stretch and resilience, helping the hoodie keep its shape while staying comfortable.

Classic Hoodie Features With Space-Inspired Style

A double-lined hood with a dyed-to-match drawcord adds warmth and a clean, finished look. The front pouch pocket gives you an easy place to warm your hands or keep small essentials close while you are on the go.

Wear Your Passion for Exploration

Whether you are launching Estes rockets, watching the next mission countdown, or simply showing off your love for NASA, the NASA SLS Hoodie is ready for the journey. It is a versatile, comfortable layer that celebrates the bold future of spaceflight in a style you can wear every day.

title: Aramid Cord
body_html:
When it comes to recovery system reliability, the Aramid Shock Cord stands out as a must-have component for rocketeers of every skill level. Built with precision and tested for strength, it offers consistent performance across a wide range of model rocket sizes.

Strength You Can Trust

Engineered to withstand the extreme forces of flight, this braided Aramid cord offers test strengths of 100 lb, 200 lb, and 300 lb. Whether you’re launching beginner-friendly rockets or advanced builds, you can count on it to provide dependable resilience with every flight.

Tailored for Model Rocketry

Designed specifically for A, B, and C motor class rockets, this shock cord provides the perfect balance of strength and flexibility. It ensures smooth ejection and recovery, protecting your rocket and parachute system from unnecessary stress.

Flexible Length Options

Our Aramid Cord is sold in convenient continuous lengths to suit your project needs: 19.6 ft for 100 lb, 13.1 ft for 200 lb, and 6.5 ft for 300 lb ratings. This allows hobbyists to cut and customize the cord exactly as needed, without wasted material.

Essential for Every Rocketeer

Durable, reliable, and versatile, the Aramid Shock Cord is an essential upgrade to your model rocket recovery system. Elevate your launches with the confidence that your rocket will return safely, flight after flight.

title: Estes Logo Beanie
body_html:
The Estes Logo Beanie is made for rocketeers who want to bring their passion for flight into every season. With a clean knit design and bold Estes logo, this beanie delivers the perfect mix of warmth, comfort, and launch-day style.

Built for Chilly Launch Days

Cool mornings at the field are part of the adventure, and the Estes Logo Beanie helps you stay comfortable while you prep, launch, and recover. Its snug fit keeps things simple, so you can focus on the countdown instead of the cold.

Comfortable Style You Can Wear Anywhere

This beanie is just as ready for everyday wear as it is for a day at the launch site. Pair it with your favorite Estes hoodie or jacket for a relaxed look that feels right at home outdoors, at events, or around town.

A Simple Way to Show Your Rocket Pride

title: Space Shuttle
body_html:
The Estes Space Shuttle is a 1:200 scale model of the iconic workhorse of the American space program. No assembly required, this beginner-friendly rocket boasts intricate details and promises thrilling launches that reach up to 600 feet! Watch in awe as the detachable boosters recover with a parachute, while the Orbiter gracefully glides back, ready for countless flights. NASA’s space shuttle fleet inspired generations, and the Estes Space Shuttle aims to do the same! From the captivating scale replica to the safe and easy flight experience, every element fuels the fire of curiosity and ignites a passion for space in enthusiasts of all ages. Display it proudly alongside the Estes 1:200 models of the Saturn V and the SLS as part of your growing fleet of iconic rockets! Perfect for ages 10 and above, this is the ideal gift for aspiring astronauts, experienced model rocketry enthusiasts, and everyone between.

Check out our free Space Shuttle STEM page!

  • Up to 600 ft. projected max altitude
  • Display stand included

title: Alpha Zip Up Hoodie

The Alpha Zip Up Hoodie brings classic Estes rocket heritage into an easy, everyday layer. Inspired by the Estes Alpha rocket, a model that has helped introduce generations to the excitement of flight since 1967, this hoodie is made for fans who know that rocketry is more than a hobby, it is a tradition worth wearing.

Comfort Built for Launch Days and Everyday Wear

Crafted from 7.8-ounce 50/50 cotton-poly fleece, this zip up hoodie offers the warmth and softness you want when the air gets cool. Air jet yarn gives the fabric a smooth, comfortable feel that makes it perfect for early mornings at the launch site, evenings around the garage, or casual days around town.

The self-fabric hood lining and dyed-to-match drawcords create a clean, timeless finish that pairs easily with your everyday style. A YKK metal zipper adds dependable durability, so this Alpha hoodie is ready for repeated wear season after season.

Made for Rocket Fans Who Live the Legacy

title: Destination Mars™ MAV™
body_html:
Talking about Destination Mars Rocket: Once again, American engineers and astronauts are being put to the test as they work towards answering the call to land humans on Mars by 2033. Estes answers the call to bring the space race to budding astronauts and enthusiasts worldwide, just like in 1958.

Meet the first release in Estes' series Destination Mars, the Mars Ascent Vehicle (MAV)! This lightweight and decorated rocket delights kids and adults while tracking NASA's achievements in reaching the next frontier. Imaginations may soar to Mars, but this MAV stays in the earth's atmosphere.

Here are the main features of Destination Mars Rocket:

  • As a beginner rocket, the MAV is easy to assemble and a great way to introduce kids and adults to the world of rocketry.
  • Designers have created the MAV to reach heights of 250 feet on a C6-3 engine. Thus, making it a perfect flyer for smaller launch sites.
  • The MAV is the first release in Estes' series Destination Mars.

Additionally, the company will release more rockets in the series in the future. This will bring enthusiasts even more options to explore the final frontier.

The MAV is perfect for smaller launch sites. Ideal for enhancing aerospace and outer space educational programs.

title: Tandem-X™ Launch Set
body_html:
Two is better than one with this Tandem-X Launch Set! This duo features two extreme, high-performance rockets and a powerful beast of a launch system. 

Designed with plastic fins, the beginner rocket Amazon stands at 30 inches tall and can be built in an hour. Launching from an Estes standard model 18 mm rocket engine C6-5, this giant can reach heights over 600 ft.

Crossfire ISX, on the other hand, is an Intermediate-level rocket that features a totally streamlined shape with aerodynamic fins and nose cone. At 15.6 inches tall and launched with Estes 18mm rocket engine C6-7, the Crossfire ISX reaches cloud busting heights of 1,150 feet. A 12-inch recovery parachute glides gently in mid-air and returns the Crossfire back to earth to launch again and again.

Both bullets of this Estes Tandem-X Launch Set take off from the sturdy Porta-Pad II Launch Pad by push button command from the Electron Beam controller.

Requirements for this set (sold separately) include:

  • Building Tools and Construction Materials
  • Finishing Supplies
  • Estes A, B or C engines
  • Batteries for Launch Controller

Learn the basics of crafting soaring models with Tandem-X Launch Set and blast these flying objects to amazing heights with Estes model number 1469! One of our most popular kits for beginners!

Bringing STEM to Life

Whether you’re refining a proven design or pushing the boundaries with something entirely new, this assortment empowers you to take full control of your builds.

All the Essential Components

Whether you’re focused on maximizing altitude, achieving smooth recoveries, or experimenting with unique fin structures, this assortment offers the parts and freedom to make it happen. Take Your Rocketry to the Next Level

Grab the Great Goblin and join the ranks of the sky conquerors! Elevate your rocketry game and let the epic adventures begin! Order yours now and prepare for liftoff into a world of excitement and wonder!

title: Sanding Paper
body_html:
The Estes Sanding Paper Set is the perfect companion for rocket builders who want precision and smooth results in every project. Featuring (2) sheets each of 80, 120, and 220 grit sandpaper, this set ensures you have the right tool for the job, whether it’s heavy shaping, medium smoothing, or fine finishing.

All-in-One Sanding Solution

No need to buy separate packs of sandpaper, this set has everything you need in one. Start with 80 grit to shape your rocket parts, move up to 120 grit for a refined surface, and finish with 220 grit for a polished, ready-to-paint finish.

Adhesive-Backed for Convenience

Each sheet comes with an adhesive backing that sticks easily to your sanding bar. No slipping, no fuss, just secure sanding every time. This feature makes switching grits quick and efficient, keeping your build process smooth and enjoyable.

Made for Rocket Perfection

From body tubes to fins, this sanding set helps you achieve the flawless finish that sets your rockets apart. Durable, reliable, and easy to use, these sandpapers are built to handle multiple uses while keeping their grit strength intact. Take your builds to the next level with Estes Sanding Paper.

title: Ultimate Sanding Bar
body_html:
The Ultimate Sanding Bar is built for makers who demand both precision and comfort. Its ergonomic design ensures a secure, natural grip so you can sand longer without fatigue. Whether you’re working on detailed edges or broad surfaces, this tool gives you confidence in every pass.

Quick and Easy Sandpaper Lock-In

Stop struggling with loose sheets. With its simple lock-and-load system, the Ultimate Sanding Bar secures sandpaper tightly in place, keeping it flat and effective. Swap sheets in seconds and keep your projects moving forward without interruption.

Versatile for Any Project

From smoothing rough cuts to preparing delicate finishing touches, the Ultimate Sanding Bar adapts to your needs. Its 2.75" x 7" size provides the ideal balance between coverage and precision, making it your go-to tool for a wide range of applications.

Everything You Need to Get Started

Each Ultimate Sanding Bar includes one sheet of 120-grit sandpaper so you can dive right into your next build. Whether you’re fine-tuning a rocket’s fins, shaping body tubes, or tackling a DIY project, this tool delivers professional-level results with ease.

title: BT-60 29mm Engine Mount Kit
body_html:
The BT-60 29mm Engine Mount Kit gives rocketeers the parts they need to build a dependable 29 mm motor mount into a BT-60 rocket. Whether you are creating a custom design, upgrading a favorite build, or replacing worn components, this kit helps turn your next project into a stronger, more capable flyer.

Designed for 29 mm Power

Built for 29 mm diameter model rocket engines, this engine mount kit is a great choice when your design calls for more motor capability. The included 8 inch engine mount tube provides a solid foundation for larger engine setups while keeping installation straightforward for experienced builders.

Clean Fit for BT-60 Rocket Builds

Three laser cut BT-60 centering rings help position the engine mount tube securely inside the body tube. The thick-walled white engine mount tube has a 1.140 inch inside diameter and 1.210 inch outside diameter, giving your rocket a durable structure where it matters most.

Complete Mounting Hardware in One Kit

With one engine mount tube, three BT-60 centering rings, and one 29 mm engine retainer included, this kit keeps your build organized from the start. It is a practical upgrade for hobbyists who enjoy custom model rocket construction and want reliable parts for their next 29 mm project.

title: BT-65 29mm Engine Mount Kit
body_html:
The BT-65 29mm Engine Mount Kit gives rocketeers a dependable foundation for building or upgrading rockets that use 29mm model rocket engines. Whether you are planning a custom design or replacing parts in a compatible build, this kit brings together the core components needed for a clean, secure motor installation.

Built for Bigger Launches

Designed for all 29mm diameter model rocket motors, this engine mount kit is ideal for hobbyists who want to move into larger motor configurations. The 8 inch thick-walled engine mount tube provides the strength and fit needed for confident performance on launch day.

Precision Parts for a Better Build

Each kit includes three laser cut BT-65 centering rings that help position the motor mount tube accurately inside the rocket body tube. With a 1.140 inch inside diameter and 1.210 inch outside diameter, the white engine mount tube is made to support a precise, reliable fit.

Includes a 29mm Engine Retainer

The included 29mm engine retainer adds convenience and security by helping hold your motor in place throughout flight. It is a smart addition for builders who want a cleaner, more dependable motor retention solution without sourcing extra parts separately.

A Smart Upgrade for Rocket Builders

For rocketeers who enjoy custom building, modifying, or upgrading Estes model rockets, the BT-65 29mm Engine Mount Kit is a practical addition to the workbench. It gives you the confidence to build around larger motors and create rockets that are ready for more exciting flights.

title: BT-80 29mm Engine Mount Kit
body_html:
The BT-80 29mm Engine Mount Kit gives model rocket builders a strong foundation for custom rockets, upgrades, and serious scratch-building projects. Designed for 29 mm model rocket engines, this kit helps you build a clean, dependable motor mount inside BT-80 size airframes.

Built for Bigger Rocket Performance

When your build calls for 29 mm power, the engine mount needs to be strong, straight, and secure. This kit includes a thick walled 8 inch engine mount tube with a 1.140 inch inside diameter and 1.210 inch outside diameter, giving your rocket the fit and support needed for 29 mm motors.

Laser Cut Centering Rings for BT-80 Builds

Three laser cut BT-80 centering rings help align the engine mount tube inside the rocket body, creating a stable, accurate motor mount assembly. Whether you are repairing, modifying, or designing your own BT-80 rocket, these rings make it easier to build with confidence.

Includes a 29mm Engine Retainer

The included 29mm engine retainer gives your motor mount a clean, practical finishing touch. It helps keep the engine secure during launch and recovery, making this BT-80 29mm Engine Mount Kit a useful addition to any builder’s parts bench.

title: F15-4 Engine Bulk Pack
body_html:
The Estes F15-4 Engine Bulk Pack gives hobby rocketeers reliable, high-performance power at a great value. This bulk pack contains everything you need to fuel eight launches - 8 F15-4 engines, 10 starters, and 8 starter plugs - making it ideal for group launches, club events, or anyone who likes to keep spare engines on hand for fast turnaround. These full-size 29 mm engines bring mid-power performance for larger model rockets while keeping handling and storage simple.

Built for rocketeers who want dependable altitude and clean, repeatable performance, the F15-4 balances strong thrust with a predictable burn profile. The engine delivers a robust 49.61 N-sec of total impulse and a 4 second delay for comfortable recovery timing, so it launches heavier hobby rockets cleanly without sacrificing control. Whether you fly for fun, display, or competition, the F15-4’s consistent ignition and stable thrust make it a favorite when you need confidence on the pad.

Key flight specs you’ll want to know - total impulse 49.61 N-sec, time delay 4 seconds, max lift weight 21.0 oz (595 g), max thrust 25.26 N, thrust duration ~3.45 seconds. Each engine measures 4.5 in (11.4 cm) long, 29 mm diameter, and weighs about 3.59 oz (101.8 g) with 2.12 oz (60.0 g) of propellant. Recovery wadding is not included, so be sure to add wadding and a properly sized parachute or streamer for safe recovery. These engines are designed for rockets that accept 29 mm motors and for flyers who follow established safety practices.

Stock up, save, and spend more time launching. The F15-4 Engine Bulk Pack is ready when you are. Add this pack to your next cart to streamline prep for club launches, backyard sessions, or classroom demo days. Always follow the NAR model rocketry safety code, use appropriate recovery wadding and a certified launch controller, and launch only in approved open areas.
