title: Alpha III® Launch Set
body_html:
A Classic That Started It All

The Alpha III is not just another model rocket, it is a piece of rocketry history. As the very first rocket in the Estes Beginner series, it has introduced hundreds of thousands of people to the thrill of launch day. Its streamlined design, lightweight construction, and dependable performance have made it a go to choice for generations of new flyers.

From the moment it leaves the pad, you will understand why this rocket has stood the test of time. It is simple, reliable, and built to deliver that unforgettable first launch experience.

Fast Build, Faster Liftoff

Getting into the air should feel exciting, not overwhelming. The Alpha III features easy to assemble components, including a one piece molded fin unit that removes the guesswork and speeds up the build. With just basic household tools and glue, you can go from opening the box to preparing for launch in about an hour.

This quick turnaround means less time building and more time launching, making it perfect for beginners who want to jump straight into the action.

High Flying Performance

Do not let its beginner friendly design fool you. The Alpha III is built to perform. Powered by standard Estes engines, it can soar up to 1150 feet, delivering a dramatic, sky stretching flight that is easy to track from liftoff to landing.

Each launch feels powerful, smooth, and rewarding, giving new rocketeers the confidence to keep flying and exploring.

Reliable Recovery Every Time

After reaching peak altitude, the Alpha III deploys a bright 12 inch parachute that brings it gently back to earth. The high visibility orange canopy makes it easy to spot in the sky, while the dependable recovery system helps ensure you can fly again and again.

This balance of performance and reliability is what makes the Alpha III such a trusted first rocket.

Launch System Included

The Alpha III Launch Set includes the Estes Porta Pad II Launch Pad and Electron Beam Launch Controller, giving you the essential hardware to support safe, repeatable launches. The stable pad design and simple controller operation make it easy to focus on the countdown and enjoy the moment of liftoff.

Just add engines and recovery wadding, and you are ready to experience the excitement of launching your own rocket.

title: Taser™ Launch Set
body_html:

The rocket kit features a brightly colored one piece body tube, molded plastic fin set and bullet shaped nose cone. Simply glue a few rocket pieces together, apply the colorful self-stick decals and in less than an hour you'll be ready for the launch pad!

  • Launch system includes the Estes Porta-Pad II Launch Pad and Electron Beam Launch Controller. Thus, you'll have everything you need for a successful launch.

With the Taser Launch Set, you can be ready for another extreme launch experience in less than an hour. So why wait? Order yours today and get ready to take your rocketry skills to new heights!

title: Alpha III®
body_html:
Join the hundreds of thousands of people who got their start in model rockets with this classic! The first rocket in the Beginner level series, the high-flying Alpha III was designed with beginners in mind.

Renown for its classic good looks, simple assembly, and excellent performance, the Alpha III beginner rocket is one of the model rocketry's best-known and most-loved designs. The black body tube, fluorescent orange nose cone and one piece fin unit makes this rocket easy-to-assemble and fun to fly! With nothing needed more then everyday household supplies and some glue, you'll be ready for liftoff in an hour.

Using Estes standard model rocket engines (sold separately), watch as the Alpha III soars to 1150 feet high. Once the rocket reaches its peak altitude, it will gently return to earth on its brightly colored, matching orange 12 inch parachute. Whether you're a first time rocketeer or a long time flyer, the Alpha III is a true classic that should be in everyone's collection.

title: Alpha®
body_html:
A Rocket That Stands the Test of Time

There must be a reason why millions of model rocketeers have bought this rocket for over three decades. With its high quality components, easy assembly, and reliable performance, the Estes Alpha rocket is the all time leading entry level rocket! This is the place to start if you are brand new to rocketry.

Easy Assembly and High Quality Components:

The Alpha is a great introduction to sanding and painting, making it a perfect step up from one of our ready to fly plastic kits. Even if you are a master rocketeer, you will find nostalgic joy in building and launching this Estes classic! Many of our customers purchase multiple Alpha's and build an entire Alpha fleet using different paint schemes. How cool is that?

Building this awesome rocket takes about an afternoon and flying is just as easy and enjoyable. When powered with a C engine, the rocket can reach cloud topping altitudes of 1000 feet. Recovery of this aerodynamic wonder is accomplished with a colorful 12 inch parachute.

Estes Alpha rocket is the best place to start for young rocket enthusiasts. Teachers and group leaders looking for exciting STEM (Science Technology Education Math) activities should look no further than the Alpha Bulk Pack to introduce students to the world of rocketry. Rocketry will hook any student who tries this rocket.

Its suggested color scheme and classy red, white and blue decals are as American as you can get. You'll feel patriotic building this sleek and colorful rocket as well as flying it.

A Rocket That Will Last for Generations:

Finally, the Alpha has been a staple in the Estes lineup for years, and will be for generations to come. The reason? It is easy to build, looks awesome, and is a great performer on the launch site. You can't ask for a better starter rocket, so get an Alpha and start flying today!

title: Hi-Flier®

Easy to Build, Easy to Fly

High Visibility Streamer Recovery

A Classic Rocket That Never Gets Old

No need to run out for extras; just load, ignite, and watch your rockets take flight again and again. This convenience makes it perfect for families, hobbyists, and anyone looking to maximize their time at the launch field.

Whether you’re stocking up for a season of launches or simply want the peace of mind of having the right engines ready to go, the Blast-Off® Bulk Pack delivers unmatched value and performance. title: Porta-Pad® II Launch Pad
body_html:
The Porta-Pad® II Launch Pad is engineered for convenience. With its quick assembly design, you’ll be ready to launch in minutes; no glue, no tools required. Simply snap the components into place, tighten the wing nut, and you’re set for a stable launch experience. Perfect for both new hobbyists and experienced flyers, this launch pad eliminates the hassle so you can focus on the countdown.

Built for Safe, Reliable Launches

Safety and reliability come standard with the Porta-Pad® II. The included blast deflector protects your rocket and pad during ignition, while the stand-off stem ensures engines ignite cleanly. The launch rod cap adds an extra layer of safety when not in use, keeping the system secure and ready for your next flight.

Adjustable Launch Angle

Designed with flexibility in mind, the Porta-Pad® II allows you to adjust your rocket’s launch direction up to 30 degrees from vertical. This feature is especially useful for breezy conditions, helping you maintain safe, accurate launches. Just loosen the wing nut, tilt the rod, and lock it back in place.

Versatile Compatibility

Whether you’re launching your first mini engine rocket or stepping up to a D-powered flyer, the Porta-Pad® II has you covered. The two-piece 1/8-inch launch rod is included, and the pad can also accommodate the 3/16-inch Maxi™ Launch Rod (sold separately). Pair it with an Electron Beam® Launch Controller (sold separately) for a complete launch system.

title: Electron Beam® Launch Controller
body_html:
The Electron Beam® Launch Controller is the essential tool for reliable and exciting rocket launches. Whether you’re testing your first rocket or adding another flight to your collection, this controller delivers dependable ignition performance. Its fully assembled design makes setup quick and easy, so you can spend more time launching and less time preparing.

Safe and Convenient Operation

Equipped with a 17 ft (5.2 m) cord, the Electron Beam® Launch Controller allows you to launch your rockets from a safe distance. This feature provides peace of mind for new rocketeers and ensures compliance with recommended safety practices. Simply connect, step back, and ignite your rocket with confidence.

Versatile Rocket Compatibility

Designed to handle a wide range of Estes engines, the Electron Beam® works seamlessly with mini, standard (A-C), and D powered rockets. Whether you’re flying smaller beginner models or larger D-powered designs, this controller is ready for the task. Its versatility makes it a great choice for rocketeers who enjoy experimenting with different rockets.

Power You Can Count On

The controller is powered by four new 1.5V AA alkaline batteries (sold separately), ensuring consistent energy for every launch. With its sturdy build and dependable circuitry, the Electron Beam® delivers reliable ignition so you can focus on the thrill of flight. Get ready to launch like a pro with a controller built for lasting performance.

title: AltiTrak™
body_html:
The Estes AltiTrak™ is the classic, hands-on way to measure your rocket’s altitude without sacrificing performance or relying on expensive altimeters. Built with an easy trigger-and-sight system, it allows you to track your rocket’s flight path up to apogee, then instantly locks in the measurement for quick reference. The process is simple, reliable, and perfect for frequent use at launches.

Designed for Learning and Fun

Ideal for educational settings, the AltiTrak transforms any rocket launch into a real-world science experiment. Students can practice data collection, compare results, and graph flight performance, all while enjoying the thrill of rocketry. It’s an excellent tool for demonstrating geometry, physics, and engineering principles in a way that’s both engaging and memorable.

Boost Accuracy with Teamwork

While a single AltiTrak provides dependable results, using two trackers in tandem delivers even greater precision. With readings taken from two different positions, students or hobbyists can apply triangulation to calculate exact altitudes. This hands-on collaboration enhances accuracy while teaching valuable teamwork and problem-solving skills.

A Must-Have for Rocketeers

Whether you’re a teacher looking to enrich your STEM curriculum or a hobbyist eager to push your rockets higher, the AltiTrak delivers practical, affordable altitude measurement. Lightweight, portable, and easy to use, it’s the perfect tool for turning every launch into a measurable success story.

title: Blast Deflector Plate
body_html:
The Blast Deflector Plate is a critical component for safe and consistent model rocket launches. Over time, the deflector that shields your launch pad from the intense heat and exhaust of rocket engines can wear down. By replacing it with a new deflector plate, you ensure your setup continues to function properly, giving you confidence on every flight.

Protect Your Launch Pad

Every launch subjects your pad to high levels of heat and force. The blast deflector plate absorbs this punishment, preserving the structure of your launch pad. A fresh deflector not only prevents damage but also promotes cleaner and more stable launches.

Compatible with Multiple Estes Launch Systems

This replacement deflector plate works seamlessly with three of Estes’ most popular launch systems: the Porta Pad II, Lifetime Launch System, and the Pro Series II Launch Pad. Whether you’re flying beginner rockets or high-performance Pro Series II models, this part keeps your launch pad ready for action.

Quick and Easy Replacement

Swapping out your worn deflector is simple and requires no special tools. Just remove the old plate, install the new one, and you’re ready to launch again. It’s the perfect way to keep your ground equipment in excellent condition without interruption to your flying schedule.

title: 1/8" Two-Piece Launch Rod
body_html:
The Estes 1/8" Two-Piece Launch Rod is a must-have replacement part for rocketeers looking to maintain safe and reliable launch conditions. At 1/8 inch in diameter, this rod is the standard size for rockets powered by Estes standard engines, making it a versatile choice for your fleet.

Stable and Reliable Launches

The launch rod plays a critical role in helping rockets achieve stable flight. As your rocket lifts off, it uses the rod to gain speed and balance before climbing into the sky. With the 1/8" Two-Piece Launch Rod, you can ensure your launches remain smooth, consistent, and successful.

Compatible with Estes Launch Pads

This launch rod is designed to fit the Estes 2215 Porta-Pad II, making it an easy replacement part for your existing setup. Its universal design also makes it a dependable option for a wide range of rockets that use standard launch lugs.

Convenient Two-Piece Design

Transporting and storing launch equipment is simple with the two-piece design. It quickly assembles when it’s time for launch and just as easily disassembles for storage in your range box or field kit. The rod also doubles as an alignment tool, making it especially useful for rockets that feature two launch lugs.

Whether you’re replacing a worn-out rod or adding an extra to your launch gear, the Estes 1/8" Two-Piece Launch Rod delivers reliable performance and convenience for every flight.

title: 3/16" Two-Piece MAXI™ Launch Rod
body_html:
When your rockets get bigger, your launch equipment needs to keep up. The 3/16" Two-Piece MAXI™ Launch Rod is designed with extra strength and length to handle larger Estes model rockets, giving them the stable boost they need to soar skyward. Made from solid steel, this rod is built to withstand repeated launches while providing smooth, reliable guidance at liftoff.

Built for Bigger Rockets

Standard rods work well for smaller models, but when you move up to rockets powered by C11, D, or E engines, a heavier-duty launch rod is essential. The MAXI™ Launch Rod helps rockets accelerate to a stable flight speed of around 30 mph before leaving the rod, ensuring safe, steady, and spectacular launches.

Convenient Two-Piece Design

Transporting and storing a full-length launch rod can be a challenge. That’s why the MAXI™ Launch Rod is built in two sections that quickly assemble for flight, then break down again for compact storage. It’s a practical solution that makes it easy to take your launch gear wherever your next flying field adventure takes you.

Compatible and Versatile

This rod attaches directly to Estes launch pads like the Porta-Pad II (#2215) and Porta-Pad E (#2238). In addition to guiding rockets at liftoff, it also serves as an excellent alignment tool for rockets equipped with two launch lugs, helping ensure straight and true launches every time.

A Must-Have for Advanced Rocketeers

If you’re stepping up to larger rockets and more powerful engines, this launch rod is a key piece of equipment. Strong, versatile, and built for performance, the 3/16" Two-Piece MAXI™ Launch Rod makes sure your biggest Estes rockets take to the sky with confidence.

title: 12 Inch Printed Parachute
body_html:
The 12 in. (30.5 cm) Printed Parachute is a reliable recovery system built for smaller model rockets. Whether you’re replacing a worn chute or outfitting a new build, this lightweight yet sturdy parachute ensures safe and gentle recoveries every time.

Ready for Launch

Convenience matters when you’re eager to fly, which is why this parachute comes fully preassembled. The shroud lines are already attached, so all you need to do is slide them through your rocket’s nose cone anchor and loop the canopy through. In just moments, your recovery system is flight-ready.

Compact Size, Maximum Performance

At 12 inches in diameter, this parachute is optimized for small rockets where space is limited but recovery is essential. Its compact profile allows it to pack easily into tight body tubes, ensuring smooth deployment without taking up unnecessary space inside your airframe.

Durable and Reusable

Made from lightweight yet strong materials, this parachute is designed to withstand repeated launches. The canopy resists tearing while the shroud lines maintain strength under stress, making it a dependable component for every flight session. With proper care, this chute can deliver consistent recoveries time and time again.

Soft Landings Every Time

The 12 in. Printed Parachute is carefully balanced to provide a slow, controlled descent. This helps protect delicate rocket fins and body tubes from hard landings, so your models stay in good condition for the next launch. It’s a simple, effective solution for safe and repeatable recovery.

title: 18 Inch Printed Parachute
body_html:
The 18 Inch Printed Parachute is designed to provide smooth, controlled recovery for your model rockets. Built from durable yet lightweight LDPE plastic, this parachute ensures consistent performance without adding unnecessary weight. Its two-color printed design makes it easy to spot in the sky or on the ground, reducing the chance of losing your rocket after a successful flight.

Preassembled and Ready to Fly

Convenience is built into every 18 Inch Printed Parachute. Preassembled with shroud lines already attached, it eliminates the need for time-consuming setup. Simply connect it to your rocket’s recovery system and you’re ready for launch. This makes it a great choice for both beginners and experienced rocketeers who want reliability without extra preparation.

Durability Meets Lightweight Design

Made from LDPE plastic, this parachute strikes the perfect balance between strength and weight. It’s durable enough to withstand multiple launches and recoveries, yet light enough to allow your rocket to reach its full altitude potential. The material also resists tearing, ensuring long-lasting performance for repeated flights.

Perfect Size for Versatile Use

At 18 inches (46 cm), this parachute is ideal for rockets that need a medium-sized recovery system. It provides a gentle descent rate, protecting your rocket from damage while ensuring a safe landing. Whether you’re building a new rocket or replacing a worn chute, the 18 Inch Printed Parachute is a reliable, ready-to-use solution.

title: 24 Inch Printed Parachute
body_html:
The Estes 24 Inch Printed Parachute is designed for model rockets that need reliable recovery with a lightweight yet strong chute. At 24 inches in diameter, this extra-large parachute provides a slower, more controlled descent, helping protect your rockets during landing. Its bold, two-color design makes it easy to spot from a distance, ensuring you never lose sight of your model in flight.

Durable Lightweight Construction

Made from die-cut LDPE plastic, this parachute strikes the perfect balance between strength and weight. The material is tough enough to handle repeated deployments while remaining light enough to pack neatly into your rocket’s airframe. This makes it an excellent choice for hobbyists who want both durability and efficiency from their recovery system.

Preassembled for Easy Use

No need to spend time cutting or tying, this parachute comes fully preassembled with shroud lines already attached. Simply anchor it to your rocket’s nose cone and you’re ready to launch. This convenience makes it especially popular with fliers who want a hassle-free setup before heading out to the launch field.

Ideal for Larger Rockets

The 24 inch size is designed for rockets that require a bigger chute to ensure a safe descent. Whether you’re flying a heavy model or just want to give your rocket a gentler landing, this parachute is the right fit. Its colorful two-tone design also adds extra visibility and style to every flight.

title: Recovery Wadding
body_html:
Every safe recovery begins with proper protection. Estes Recovery Wadding is specifically designed to safeguard your rocket’s parachute from the intense heat and pressure created by the motor’s ejection charge. Using recovery wadding helps prevent melting, scorching, or damage that can shorten the life of your recovery system.

Flame-Resistant and Reliable

Made from flame-resistant material, recovery wadding absorbs the force and heat of the ejection charge while allowing your parachute to deploy smoothly. Placed between the engine and recovery system, it adds a critical layer of protection to every launch.

Simple and Beginner Friendly

Recovery wadding is quick and easy to install, making it perfect for rocketeers of all experience levels. Depending on engine size, only a few sheets are needed to prepare your rocket for flight, helping you launch with confidence every time.

Ready for Repeated Launches

Each package includes approximately 72 sheets of recovery wadding, enough for approximately 18-25 launches. Stocking up ensures you are always prepared for safe recoveries and successful missions, launch after launch.

title: Shock Cords & Mount Pack
body_html:
The Shock Cords & Mount Pack is a must-have accessory for every model rocketeer. Designed to provide strength and reliability, this set gives you multiple shock cord options to keep your rockets flying and landing safely. By absorbing the stresses of parachute deployment, these cords ensure your rocket stays intact after every launch.

Durable Rubber Construction

Each shock cord is made from high-quality rubber that combines strength with flexibility. This material is designed to handle repeated stretching and recovery events, giving you confidence that your rocket’s recovery system will perform launch after launch. With two different cord sizes included, you’ll be equipped to handle both small and larger model rockets.

All-in-One Pack

The set includes two 1/8 in. x 18 in. cords and one 1/4 in. x 36 in. cord, offering the perfect range of lengths and diameters for different rocket builds. You’ll also receive four shock cord mounts, making it easy to securely attach your cords to your rocket’s body tube or nose cone. With the included instructions, even beginners can install these components with ease.

Reliable Recovery Every Time

Shock cords play a critical role in rocket recovery by preventing separation between the rocket’s stages and recovery device. This pack ensures that your rockets return safely to the ground, minimizing damage and maximizing flight fun. Perfect for replacements, upgrades, or new builds, the Shock Cords & Mount Pack is a reliable addition to your rocket-building toolkit.

title: Launch Lug Pack
body_html:
The Estes Launch Lug Pack is a must-have accessory for model rocket builders who like to be prepared. With 16 spiral wound paper launch lugs in four useful sizes, this pack makes it easy to replace missing parts, repair well-loved rockets, or add the right launch guide to a custom build.

Built for Smooth, Stable Launches

Launch lugs play a simple but important role in getting your rocket safely and cleanly off the pad. When properly attached to the rocket body, they guide the rocket along the launch rod during ignition, helping support a straight, stable liftoff.

Four Sizes for More Flexibility

This launch lug assortment includes four sizes to support different rocket designs and launch setups: 1/8 in. x 1 1/4 in., 3/16 in. x 2 in., 1/8 in. x 2 3/8 in., and 1/4 in. x 1 in. Each size comes with four lugs, giving you a total of 16 pieces in one convenient pack.

A Smart Addition to Every Parts Box

Compatible with 1/8 inch, 3/16 inch, and 1/4 inch diameter launch rods, the Launch Lug Pack is a versatile accessory for hobbyists, builders, and longtime Estes fans. Keep a pack on hand and you will always be ready for your next repair, kitbash, or scratch-built rocket project.

title: BT-20 Body Tubes (4 pk)
body_html:
The BT-20 Body Tube is a workshop essential for builders who love creating, customizing, and flying their own model rockets. Made from high quality spiral wound kraft paper, this tube provides the reliable strength and smooth surface finish you need for confident launches and clean paint jobs.

Built for Versatile Rocket Designs

The BT-20 size is a trusted standard in model rocketry, making it ideal for a wide range of compatible kits and scratch builds. Whether you are replacing a damaged tube or engineering a brand new design, this body tube gives you a solid foundation to bring your rocket to life.

Extend Your Creativity

Want to build taller, sleeker, or more ambitious rockets? Simply use tube couplers to connect tubes of the same diameter and create custom lengths tailored to your design goals. Pair with the NC-20 nose cone for a precise fit and a clean, professional look from tip to tail.

Stock Up and Start Building

Each package includes four BT-20 body tubes, so you are always ready for your next project. Keep them on hand for repairs, experiments, or your next big idea, and turn your workbench into a launchpad for creativity.

title: BT-50 Body Tubes (3 pk)
body_html:
The BT-50 Body Tube is a go to choice for builders who want reliable performance and clean, professional results. Crafted from high quality spiral wound paper, this tube offers the ideal balance of strength and lightweight performance for a wide range of model rocket designs.

Built for Custom Creativity

Designing your own rocket is part of the fun, and the BT-50 body tube gives you a versatile foundation to build on. Use tube couplers to connect tubes of the same diameter and create longer, more impressive rockets that stand out on the launch pad.

Dependable Fit and Compatibility

This tube is sized specifically for BT-50 based kits and components, ensuring a consistent fit with compatible parts. It works seamlessly with the NC-50 nose cone, making it easy to plan and complete your build with confidence.

Stock Up and Start Building

With three tubes included in every package, you can tackle multiple projects or keep spares ready for repairs and upgrades. Whether you are replacing a damaged tube or launching your next original design, the BT-50 Body Tube is ready to help you build, customize, and fly.

title: BT-55 Body Tubes (3 pk)
body_html:
The BT-55 Body Tube is a go to choice for rocketeers who want versatility, durability, and clean performance. Crafted from high quality spiral wound paper, this tube provides a smooth surface that is easy to sand, prime, and paint for a professional finish every time.

Built for Custom Rocket Projects

If you love designing your own rockets, the BT-55 body tube gives you room to think bigger. Its larger diameter opens the door for creative payload sections, bold paint schemes, and eye catching profiles that stand out on the launch field.

Designed for Seamless Compatibility

This tube is made specifically for kits and custom builds that use BT-55 components. It pairs perfectly with the NC-55 nose cone, and with standard tube couplers you can easily join multiple tubes of the same diameter to create extended airframes.

Stock Up and Keep Building

Each package includes three BT-55 body tubes, so you are always ready for your next build session. Whether you are repairing a favorite rocket or sketching out a brand new design, these tubes help turn your ideas into high flying reality.

title: BT-60 Body Tubes (3 pk)
body_html:
The Estes BT-60 Body Tube is a workshop essential for model rocket builders who want versatility and performance in one dependable component. With its classic diameter and 18 inch length, it provides the perfect foundation for mid size rockets that stand out on the pad and perform in the sky.

Built for Reliable Performance

Crafted from high quality spiral wound paper, each BT-60 body tube offers impressive strength while remaining lightweight. This balance helps support smooth liftoffs, stable flight, and dependable recoveries, giving you confidence every time you press the launch button.

Perfect for Scratch Builds and Repairs

Designing your own custom rocket or restoring a well flown favorite is easy with BT-60 body tubes on hand. Use tube couplers to seamlessly connect multiple tubes of the same diameter for extended airframes, payload sections, or ambitious multi stage concepts.

Stock Your Rocket Workshop

With three tubes included in every package, you will always be ready for your next burst of inspiration. Pair them with compatible NC-60 nose cones and other Estes components to create a rocket that is uniquely yours, then head to the field and watch your vision soar.

title: BT-80 Body Tubes (2 pk)
body_html:
The BT-80 Body Tube is made for rocketeers who want to build something big. With a wide diameter, lightweight Kraft paper construction, and a 14.2 inch length, this body tube gives your custom rocket the size and strength needed for impressive flights and standout designs.

Build Bigger Custom Rockets

Use a single BT-80 body tube for a bold single stage rocket, or connect multiple tubes with compatible BT-80 tube couplers to create an extended airframe. Whether you are designing a payload rocket, a sport flyer, or an oversized custom build, the BT-80 body tube gives you a strong starting point.

Ready for 24 mm and 29 mm Possibilities

With the right Estes motor mount components, laser cut ring sets, and compatible hardware, BT-80 body tubes can be used in rockets powered by select 24 mm or 29 mm engines. Builders can design around Estes C11, D12, E12, E16, or F15 engine options depending on their rocket configuration, build requirements, and launch goals.

A Great Choice for Payloaders and Egg Lofting

The larger BT-80 diameter makes this body tube especially useful for payload rockets, egg lofting projects, and competition-inspired designs. Pair it with a compatible NC-80K or NC-80B nose cone to create a sleek, capable rocket with room for payloads and plenty of sky-high potential.

Strong, Lightweight Kraft Paper Construction

Spiral wound Kraft paper keeps the BT-80 Body Tube lightweight while still providing the durability needed for serious model rocket building. From repairs and replacements to ambitious scratch builds, this 2 pack gives hobbyists the foundation to create rockets that look impressive on the pad and even better in flight.

title: Engine Hook Accessory Pack
body_html:
The Estes Engine Hook Accessory Pack provides rocket enthusiasts with a reliable solution for securing engines of multiple sizes. Engine hooks are one of the simplest yet most critical parts of a model rocket, ensuring that your motor stays locked in place during liftoff and recovery. This pack covers all your needs with 7 hooks, conveniently sized for the most commonly used Estes engines.

Multiple Sizes for Every Build

This pack comes with hooks for mini engines (2), standard and D engines (3), and E engines (2), giving you full compatibility with a wide range of Estes rockets. Whether you’re working on a beginner model or a larger advanced build, these hooks ensure the proper fit and performance you need.

Durable and Reusable

Crafted to handle repeated use, Estes engine hooks are built tough to withstand multiple flights. You can reuse them across different builds, making this pack a cost-effective and dependable choice for any rocketeer.

Quick and Easy Installation

Designed for convenience, these hooks allow you to swap out engines with minimal effort. No tools or complicated steps required, just clip the hook into place, insert your engine, and you’re ready to launch. It’s the perfect upgrade or replacement part for any model rocket hobbyist.

title: Regular Engine Mount Kit
body_html:
The Estes Regular Engine Mount Kit is designed to provide rocketeers with a dependable and versatile solution for engine mounting. This kit works seamlessly with BT-50, BT-55, BT-56, and BT-60 body tubes, making it a go-to accessory for both new builds and repairs. Each kit comes with BT-20 (0.74 in. / 19 mm) engine mount tubes that ensure secure installation and optimal engine alignment.

Versatile and Practical

One of the standout features of this kit is its ability to serve multiple purposes. Beyond traditional engine mounting, it can be used to create a conversion mount for lightweight D-powered rockets, expanding your build possibilities. Whether you’re experimenting with new designs or updating older models, this kit adapts to your needs.

Easy Assembly with Instructions

Designed with hobbyists in mind, the kit includes complete, step-by-step instructions. Even newer rocketeers can follow along and achieve a secure, professional-quality engine mount. Clear directions make the process fast and hassle-free, so you can spend less time assembling and more time launching.

Reliable Performance Every Launch

Durability and precision are at the core of this engine mount kit. Each component is engineered to withstand the stresses of repeated flights, ensuring consistent performance from liftoff to recovery. With this kit in your workshop, you’ll always have a reliable solution for your next project.

title: D and E Engine Mount Kit
body_html:
The Estes D and E Engine Mount Kit brings professional-grade reliability to your rocket building projects. With enough parts to mount two 24 mm engines, this kit ensures your rockets can handle the higher thrust of D and E engines while maintaining stability and performance. Whether you’re flying for fun or competition, these mounts provide the foundation for success.

Engineered for Strength and Compatibility

This accessory pack is tailored for BT-55, BT-60, and BT-80 body tubes, giving builders flexibility in design. With laser-cut centering rings and precision-wound motor tubes, your engines will sit perfectly aligned for maximum efficiency. Each part is made to withstand repeated launches, making this kit a smart investment for serious hobbyists.

All the Parts You Need

Inside the kit, you’ll find 19 carefully crafted components, including centering rings, engine blocks, mounting tubes, hook retainers, spacers, and both D and E engine hooks. These parts work together to keep your engines locked in place during ignition and flight, ensuring smooth operation and dependable recoveries. Builders can use the included spacer to adapt between engine sizes, giving even more flexibility in design.

Perfect for Builders and Competitors

From classroom projects to ARC competitions, the Estes D and E Engine Mount Kit gives you the tools to build with confidence. With its durability and precision, this kit helps rockets reach higher altitudes and perform reliably launch after launch. It’s an essential upgrade for anyone looking to get the most out of their 24 mm engines.

Kit Contents

This kit includes:

  • 30052 - Large Diameter Laser Cut Centering Ring (1)
  • 30132 - Small Diameter Laser Cut Centering Ring (1)
  • 30166-2 - AR-5055 Green Adapter Ring (4)
  • 30164-2 - AR-2050 Green Engine Block (3)
  • 30368 - BT-50 Engine Mounting Tube (3)
  • 30480 - Black Engine Hook Retainer (2)
  • 35005 - Spacer E to D (1)
  • 35021 - D Engine Hook (1)
  • 35022 - E Engine Hook (1)

title: NC-5 Nose Cone (5 pk)
body_html:
The NC-5 Nose Cone 5 Pack is a must-have accessory for rocketeers building, repairing, or customizing rockets that use BT-5 body tubes. With five nose cones included, it gives you the flexibility to complete multiple small rocket projects or keep replacement parts ready for future launches.

A Clean Fit for BT-5 Rocket Builds

Designed specifically for BT-5 body tubes, each NC-5 nose cone helps create the smooth, finished profile every model rocket needs. It is a simple but essential part that brings shape, balance, and classic Estes style to your build.

Built for Recovery System Attachment

This pack also includes five nose cone pins that glue into the nose cones for parachute and shock cord attachment. That makes it easier to complete your recovery setup and prepare your rocket for reliable launch-day performance.

Perfect for Repairs and Scratch Building

Whether you are replacing a lost nose cone, rebuilding a favorite rocket, or creating your own BT-5 design from scratch, this 5 pack keeps your parts box stocked. It is a small accessory that opens the door to more creativity, more repairs, and more flights.

title: NC-20 Nose Cone (4 pk)
body_html:
The NC-20 Nose Cone 4 pack is a simple but essential addition to any model rocket builder’s parts bin. Made to fit BT-20 body tubes, these nose cones help give your rocket projects the finished shape they need for a classic Estes look and dependable flight-ready construction.

Perfect for Repairs, Replacements, and Scratch Builds

Whether you are replacing a lost or damaged nose cone or designing a custom rocket from the ground up, this pack gives you the parts you need to keep building. With four NC-20 nose cones included, you can complete multiple projects or keep extras on hand for your next launch-day idea.

Designed for BT-20 Body Tubes

These nose cones are made for use with Estes BT-20 body tubes, making them a convenient choice for compatible builds and modifications. Their easy-fit design helps hobbyists spend less time searching for parts and more time creating rockets they are excited to paint, finish, and fly.

Includes Nose Cone Pins for Recovery Attachments

Each package includes four nose cone pins for shock cord and shroud line attachments. That added convenience makes the NC-20 Nose Cone 4 pack a practical accessory for builders who want clean assembly, reliable recovery setup, and more flexibility at the workbench.

title: NC-55 Nose Cone (4 pk)
body_html:
The Estes NC-55 Nose Cone 4 Pack is a practical accessory for rocketeers who love building, repairing, and customizing their model rockets. Made to fit BT-55 body tubes, these nose cones are a reliable choice for keeping your rocket projects moving from the workbench to the launch field.

Built for BT-55 Rocket Projects

Whether you are replacing a damaged nose cone or designing a rocket from scratch, the NC-55 gives your BT-55 body tube the clean, finished profile it needs. Its simple, versatile shape makes it easy to use across a variety of model rocket designs.

Four Nose Cones for More Building Possibilities

Each package includes four NC-55 nose cones, giving you extra parts for future builds, repairs, or experiments. Keep them in your parts box and you will be ready when inspiration strikes or when a favorite rocket needs a quick replacement.

Easy Recovery System Attachment

Every NC-55 nose cone includes an eyelet for shock cord and shroud line attachments, making recovery setup simple and dependable. It is a small detail that helps make the building process smoother, especially when you are working on custom rockets or replacing worn components.

title: NC-56 Nose Cone (4 pk)
body_html:
The NC-56 Nose Cone 4 Pack gives model rocket builders a dependable set of nose cones designed specifically for BT-56 body tubes. Whether you are replacing a damaged part, planning a custom rocket, or stocking your workshop with essential components, this pack helps keep your next build moving.

Made for BT-56 Rocket Projects

Each NC-56 nose cone is sized to fit BT-56 body tubes, making it a useful choice for compatible Estes model rocket builds and custom designs. The clean, classic profile gives your rocket a finished look while helping complete the aerodynamic shape needed for smooth flight.

Four Nose Cones for More Building Possibilities

With four nose cones in every package, you can work on multiple rockets, keep replacement parts ready, or experiment with different paint schemes and designs. It is a practical pack for hobbyists who like having the right model rocket parts available when inspiration strikes.

Easy Recovery System Attachment

Each NC-56 nose cone includes an eyelet for attaching a shock cord and parachute shroud lines. That built-in detail makes it easier to create a secure recovery setup, so you can focus on the fun parts of building, finishing, and getting ready for launch day.

title: NC-80B Nose Cone
body_html:
The NC-80B Nose Cone combines aerodynamic efficiency with rugged construction, making it a dependable choice for builders and hobbyists. Its blunt, blow-molded profile ensures stable performance while reducing stress on your recovery system during ejection.

Made from high-impact polystyrene (HIPS), this nose cone balances strength and light weight to help your rocket achieve higher altitudes without sacrificing durability. The material resists cracking and deformation, even after repeated launches.

Designed for compatibility, the NC-80B fits securely into BT-80 body tubes. The integrated shoulder provides a snug fit, while the molded eyelet makes attaching shock cords and parachutes quick and reliable.

Whether you’re building a custom design or replacing a worn component, the NC-80B delivers proven Estes quality and dependable flight performance.

title: Large Tube Coupler Pack
body_html:
The Large Tube Coupler Pack makes it simple to expand your rocket designs or repair damaged body tubes. Crafted to fit BT-55, BT-56, BT-60, and BT-80 tubes, this set is a must-have accessory for any builder working with Estes’ larger body sizes. Each coupler slides smoothly into place, creating a secure connection that keeps your rocket stable during flight.

Build Bigger and Better

By joining multiple body tubes, these couplers allow you to extend your rocket’s airframe and create unique designs. Whether you’re aiming for taller rockets, payload sections, or just experimenting with new builds, the couplers give you the freedom to push your creativity further.

Essential for Repairs

Accidents happen, but with the Large Tube Coupler Pack you can quickly repair and reinforce damaged rockets. Instead of retiring a favorite model, use these couplers to restore strength and keep it flying for many more launches.

Reliable Performance

Each coupler is designed to hold your rocket’s sections firmly in place, providing the structural integrity needed for successful flights. With multiple sizes included in the pack, you’ll always have the right piece ready for your next project or repair.

title: E Launch Controller
body_html:
The Estes E Launch Controller is your go-to solution when flying rockets powered by larger “E” engines. While specially designed to handle the demands of higher-thrust motors, it’s also compatible with all Estes engine sizes, giving you flexibility for your entire fleet.

Safe and Reliable Operation

Safety comes first with the E Launch Controller. Featuring a built-in safety key, a continuity check light, and a secure launch button, you’ll have peace of mind knowing every launch is both controlled and dependable. Whether you’re launching your first rocket or your fiftieth, this controller ensures smooth countdowns and confident ignition.

Extended Range for Added Safety

With 30 feet of cable included, you can maintain a safe distance from the launch pad without sacrificing control. The added length provides extra security, especially when launching powerful E-engine models that soar to impressive altitudes.

Easy to Use

Simple, straightforward, and effective, the E Launch Controller gets you flight-ready in minutes. All you need are 4 “AA” alkaline batteries (sold separately), and you’ll be set to push that classic “Launch” button and send your rockets skyward.

title: Porta-Pad E® Launch Pad
body_html:
The Porta-Pad E® Launch Pad takes your rocketry to the next level with a design built for strength, stability, and ease of use. Whether you’re upgrading from a beginner pad or preparing for your first high-power launch, this pad delivers reliable performance that grows with your skills.

Durable Construction for High-Power Launches

Unlike lighter launch pads, the Porta-Pad E® features a stronger base and beefier blast deflector. This makes it ideal for rockets powered by “E” engines and ensures your pad can withstand launch after launch without wearing down. It’s the go-to choice for model rocketeers who want a launch pad that lasts.

Quick and Easy Setup

Say goodbye to complicated assembly. The Porta-Pad E® requires no glue or tools, simply snap the pieces together and you’re ready to launch. In just a few minutes, you can have your rocket prepped and on the pad, leaving more time for countdowns and liftoffs.

Flexible Launch Options

This launch pad comes with a 1/4 in. (6 mm) rod, perfect for larger rockets. For added versatility, it can also accommodate the 3/16 in. (5 mm) Maxi Launch Rod (sold separately). This flexibility means you can launch a wider range of rockets, from mid-size builds to those requiring a bit more guidance at liftoff.

Designed to Work with Your Estes Controller

Pair the Porta-Pad E® with the Estes “E” Launch Controller for a powerful setup that ensures safe, smooth, and thrilling launches. Together, they create a reliable launch system that delivers excitement every time you push the launch button.

title: Tube Marking Guide
body_html:
The Tube Marking Guide takes the guesswork out of rocket building by helping you create perfect reference lines on your rocket’s body tube. Whether you’re marking fin slots or launch lug placement, this tool ensures consistent accuracy so your rockets fly straighter and perform better.

Includes a Fin Gluing Jig

Beyond marking, this guide also comes with a built-in fin gluing jig. By holding the fins steady while adhesive dries, it eliminates the struggle of keeping fins aligned by hand. This feature makes assembly smoother and results more reliable, even for complex builds.

Perfect for Builders of All Levels

Beginners will love how easy it makes rocket construction, while experienced hobbyists will appreciate the improved precision and efficiency. By removing errors and saving time, the Tube Marking Guide helps rocketeers of all skill levels achieve professional-quality results.

A Must-Have for Every Toolkit

Compact, lightweight, and highly useful, the Tube Marking Guide is a tool you’ll reach for again and again. From your first build to your most advanced designs, it ensures every rocket looks sharp, flies straight, and recovers safely.

Despite being a mini engine, the 1/2A3-4T packs plenty of power and offers reliable performance. It’s an excellent choice for younger rocketeers or group activities where keeping rockets in sight makes launches more engaging and manageable. Estes engines are precision manufactured for consistent results, giving you peace of mind with every countdown.

Bulk packs are a smart way to prepare for group launches or multiple flights in one session. title: Rascal™ & HiJinks™ Launch Set
body_html:
If you want the thrill of model rocketry without the wait, this is your launch set. The Rascal and HiJinks model rockets come pre-built and ready to fly right out of the box. There is no painting, no gluing, and no complicated setup involved.

Simply attach the 12 inch parachutes, prepare your engines at the field, and you are ready for liftoff. In just minutes, you can go from opening the box to watching your rocket streak into the sky.

Double the Rockets, Double the Action

Why settle for one launch when you can send up two? The Rascal™ & HiJinks™ Launch Set is built for shared excitement. Challenge a friend to see who flies higher, or take turns sending each rocket skyward. It is the perfect way to turn any open field into your own launch site.

Both rockets are lightweight, durable, and capable of reaching projected altitudes up to 1,100 feet on recommended engines such as the A8-3, B4-4, B6-4, C6-5, and C6-7. With the optional engine adapter, sold separately, they can also fly on A10-3T engines for added versatility.

Launch System Included

This complete launch set includes the dependable Porta-Pad II Launch Pad and the easy to use Electron Beam Launch Controller. The stable pad and 1/8 inch launch rod help guide your rocket straight off the pad, while the controller delivers that classic push button ignition moment every rocketeer loves.

To get started, simply add Estes engines, recovery wadding, starters, and AA batteries. Bring everything to the field and you have a full model rocket launch experience ready to go.

High Flying Performance for New Rocketeers

Each rocket measures 14.5 inches in length, 0.98 inches in diameter, and weighs just 1.5 ounces. Molded plastic fins provide added strength and durability for repeated flights, while the parachute recovery system ensures gentle landings and quick turnaround for your next launch.

From your first countdown to your hundredth launch, the Rascal™ & HiJinks™ Launch Set delivers reliable performance, simple setup, and twice the sky soaring fun. If you are looking for a ready to fly model rocket launch set that brings instant excitement, this is the one to grab.

title: 6 Inch Printed Parachute
body_html:
The Estes 6 in. (15.2 cm) Printed Parachute is designed to give your smaller model rockets a reliable and colorful recovery system. Preassembled and ready to go, it makes getting your rocket flight-ready easier than ever. Simply attach the shroud lines to your rocket’s nose cone and enjoy safe, controlled descents after every launch.

Perfect for Small Rockets

Some rockets require a smaller parachute to ensure proper recovery without drifting too far from the launch site. At just 6 inches across, this parachute is lightweight and compact, making it ideal for rockets with smaller airframes or limited recovery space.

Durable and Reusable

Constructed with lightweight yet durable material, the 6 in. parachute can withstand the stresses of deployment and recovery. Its dependable design allows you to enjoy multiple flights without worrying about premature wear or damage.

Easy to Spot, Easy to Use

The bold two-color printed design makes your rocket easier to track as it descends, adding both visibility and style to your launch experience. With its preattached shroud lines and fully assembled build, setup takes only seconds so you can spend less time preparing and more time launching.

title: Mini Honest John
body_html:
The Mini Honest John is a sport-scaled model of a U.S. battle field artillery missile. A molded nose cone and laser cut wood fins grace this detailed flyer. Made of balsa wood fins, this rocket is solid and can withstand high intensity launches.

Although simple in construction, the resulting model in Mini Honest John features plenty of detail that you will be proud to display. To camouflage this military flyer, assemble for an hour and paint green, then fly this rocket in a field with tall grass. Experience how Honest John will be impossible to find.

Use the mini engine mount included to fly on an Estes A10-3T or use a standard mount and fly on an A8-3T engines. The nose cone of this rocket kit is versatile and fits BT-20, BT-50 and BT-55 tubes.

Requirements for this rocket (sold separately):

title: Fin Alignment Guide
body_html:
The Fin Alignment Guide takes the guesswork out of rocket building, giving you perfect fin placement every time. Its precision-molded design ensures stability and speed, making it one of the most valuable tools in any rocketeer’s workshop. Whether building for fun or performance, this accessory will help you achieve straighter flights and cleaner builds.

Precision and Speed

Attaching fins by hand often leads to uneven angles and unstable flights. With this alignment guide, you can position your fins quickly and accurately without the frustration of constant adjustments. Once set in place, your fins stay steady while the adhesive cures, ensuring a strong and reliable bond.

Adaptable to Your Builds

Designed to work with a wide range of rockets, the Fin Alignment Guide supports body tubes from BT-20 to BT-80. Its adjustable holders allow for both three- and four-fin configurations, giving you the flexibility to create custom designs or replicate proven builds. This versatility makes it a go-to tool for builders who work across multiple rocket sizes.

Built for Serious Modelers

Whether you’re crafting your first rocket or fine-tuning a competitive build, the Fin Alignment Guide brings consistency and professionalism to your projects. Compatible with 3/32 in. and 1/8 in. balsa, bass, or plywood fins, it supports common materials used in rocketry. Durable, practical, and easy to use, this tool helps ensure that every launch is as successful as the last.

title: Der Red Max™ Parachute
body_html:
The highly sought-after Der Red Max™ parachute is here, now available separately for the first time. This 18 in. (46 cm) parachute not only performs exceptionally well but also adds a burst of personality to your rocket with its bold, unmistakable design.

Classic Der Red Max Styling

Known for its mischievous look and iconic graphics, the Der Red Max has long been a fan-favorite in the Estes lineup. This parachute carries that same distinctive personality, making every launch and recovery just a little more fun. It’s not just about performance, it’s about flying with attitude.

Reliable Recovery Performance

Measuring 18 inches in diameter, this parachute is sized to safely recover mid-sized model rockets. Made from lightweight yet durable plastic, it provides a steady descent and reduces landing impact, ensuring your rocket comes back ready for its next flight.

Flexible Setup Options

Whether you’re replacing the original Der Red Max parachute or outfitting another rocket, this chute offers versatility and performance in one package. It’s a functional part of your recovery system and an easy way to upgrade your fleet.

A Must-Have for Collectors and Flyers

Fans of the Der Red Max will appreciate the chance to own this parachute as a separate piece. It’s a collectible accessory that carries the personality and charm of one of Estes’ most beloved rockets, while delivering dependable recovery at every launch.

title: Engine Adapters - Mini to Standard
body_html:
The Estes Engine Adapters Mini to Standard are the perfect way to maximize your launch options without needing separate rockets for every engine size. Simply place your mini engine inside the adapter, then slide it into your rocket’s standard engine mount, and you’re ready to fly. This quick process makes swapping between engines easier than ever.

Reusable and Reliable

Each adapter is made for repeated use, so you can keep them in your launch kit and rely on them flight after flight. Instead of buying multiple rockets or limiting your engine options, these adapters ensure your mini engines remain useful long after your first few launches.

Expand Your Launch Possibilities

Designed for rockets up to 2 ounces in weight, this adapter allows you to use powerful mini engines like the A10-3T in rockets typically launched with A8-3 engines. That means more variety, more performance options, and more fun on launch day.

A Must-Have for Rocket Enthusiasts

Whether you’re building a fleet of rockets or want more flexibility from your existing collection, the Estes Engine Adapters Mini to Standard are an essential accessory. With three adapters in each pack, you’ll always have the right fit ready to go.

title: Engine Adapters - Standard to D
body_html:
The Estes Standard to D Engine Adapters open the door to new possibilities for your model rockets. Instead of being limited to D-size engines, you can now easily fly your D-mount rockets with standard size engines. This means more flexibility in how you enjoy your launches, whether you want shorter, lower flights for small fields or simply to extend your engine options.

Quick and Easy to Use

With only two steps, you’re ready to launch. Simply insert your standard engine into the adapter and then place the adapter into your rocket’s D mount. No complicated modifications or tools are required, making it perfect for beginners and experienced rocketeers alike.

Durable and Reusable

Each adapter is built to withstand repeated use, ensuring you get lasting value. With three adapters in every pack, you’ll always have spares ready to go, making this accessory a dependable addition to your rocketry toolkit.

Compatible and Versatile

These adapters are tested with Estes metal engine hooks, ensuring reliable performance and secure fitting. Designed for rockets weighing up to 4 ounces, they let you enjoy flights on B and C engines when you’d normally need a C11 or D12, offering more flexibility depending on your launch conditions.

title: Pro Series II™ Recovery Wadding
body_html:
Recovery wadding plays a critical role in every successful rocket flight. By absorbing the force and heat of the ejection charge, it prevents damage to parachutes and streamers, helping ensure safe and controlled recoveries.

Built for Pro Series II Performance

Pro Series II rockets generate more power and require added protection during deployment. This recovery wadding is specifically designed to meet those demands, making it a trusted choice for larger, high performance rockets.

Versatile Across Your Rocket Fleet

While optimized for Pro Series II models, this recovery wadding works just as well with smaller Estes rockets. It is a reliable solution for beginners and experienced flyers alike.

Fly More with Confidence

With approximately 225 flame resistant squares per bag, you can enjoy multiple launches without frequent restocking. Protect your recovery system, extend the life of your gear, and focus on the thrill of flight.

title: Hi-Flier® XL
body_html:
An Icon, Reimagined at Full Scale

The Hi-Flier® XL is an upsized take on one of the most popular rockets ever made, giving you a familiar design with a whole new level of presence. At over 30 inches tall, it stands confidently on the launch pad, instantly setting the stage for a flight that feels bigger in every way.

Its clean lines and classic profile are more than just good looks. This is a rocket built to perform, designed to cut through the air with efficiency and stability as it climbs.

Power That Delivers Real Altitude

When you load up the Hi-Flier XL with C11, D, or E engines, you are unlocking the kind of performance that defines high-power model rocketry. With projected flights reaching over 1300 feet, each launch delivers a dramatic ascent that pulls your eyes skyward from liftoff to apogee.

The versatility in engine options means you can tailor each flight to the field, the conditions, or the experience you want. From strong, steady climbs to full-throttle altitude runs, this rocket responds every time.

Built for Builders Ready to Step Up

This advanced level kit strikes the perfect balance between challenge and reward. Featuring laser cut balsa fins, a molded nose cone, and a streamlined single body tube, the build process is engaging without being overwhelming.

It is the kind of project that feels satisfying from the first assembly step to the final coat of paint. You are not just building a rocket, you are building something you will be proud to fly.

Reliable Recovery, Flight After Flight

A bright 18 inch parachute ensures smooth, controlled recoveries that are easy to track and retrieve. Even after a high-altitude flight, the Hi-Flier XL returns gently, ready to be prepped and launched again.

This consistency means more flights, less downtime, and more time enjoying what matters most, watching your rocket soar.

A Flight Experience Worth Chasing

The Hi-Flier XL delivers that perfect moment every rocketeer looks for. The countdown, the ignition, and the instant it leaves the rail with authority. It is a clean, powerful launch followed by a long, satisfying climb that feels earned.

If you are ready for bigger builds and higher flights, this is the rocket that makes that step feel unforgettable.

title: Tube Cutting Guides
body_html:
Tube Cutting Guides from Estes give you a reliable, no-fuss way to trim body tubes to exact lengths. Designed for model rocketry builders who value neat finishes and repeatable results, these guides reduce sanding, rework, and wasted material so your builds look and fly their best.

Built for Precision

Each guide slips snugly over a tube and lines up your cut so it comes out square and true. The included BT5, BT20, BT50, BT55, and BT60 sizes cover the most commonly used Estes body tubes for effortless, accurate customization.

Simple, Fast Workflow

No special jigs or complicated measuring are needed. Simply slip on the guide, score or cut to the guide edge, and you’re done. That streamlined process saves time on every build and helps keep your workflow focused on assembly and finishing.

Made to Last, Built to Travel

Constructed from durable plastic, the guides hold their shape and measurement accuracy through repeated use. They’re compact enough to carry to launch days or club meets so you can tweak parts on the fly and get back to flying.

title: Pro Series II™ 29 mm Motor Retainer Set
body_html:
The Pro Series II™ 29 mm Motor Retainer Set brings unmatched convenience to your rocketry experience. title: Mercury Redstone 4/ Liberty Bell 7
body_html:
When Gus Grissom climbed into the cockpit of his Mercury spacecraft on the morning of July 21, 1961, he was ready for an adventure. Grissom’s Mercury mission (MR-4) was the second of the series, and like Alan Shephard before him, it was a sub-orbital lob. The Redstone rocket would take Gus and his spacecraft, dubbed Liberty Bell 7, above the atmosphere, but not quite fast enough to achieve orbit. The launch was on time and perfect, as was the short period of weightless flight, and re-entry through the atmosphere. Liberty Bell 7 deployed its main parachute as expected and landed within two miles of the Navy recovery team. Gus secured the spacecraft and waited to be rescued. However, without warning, the explosive hatch blew off and the spacecraft begin to take on water. Grissom escaped but nearly drowned in his spacesuit. Liberty Bell 7 filled with seawater and sank to the bottom of the Atlantic. It was the only NASA spacecraft ever lost at sea.

The Estes Mercury Redstone 4 is an impressive 1:34 scale model of the historic NASA spacecraft and rocket. The finished kit stands nearly 29 inches tall and features laser-cut, layered balsa fins and a molded plastic model of Grissom’s Liberty Bell 7 and it’s Launch Escape System (LES). The set of detailed water-slide decals even includes the distinctive white “crack” that Gus painted onto the side of his spacecraft to make it resemble the actual Liberty Bell. This Advanced kit is a “must have” for all serious model rocketeers! Put the Mercury Redstone 4 on the flight line and countdown to launch, and watch it reach altitudes up to 200 feet on a C6-3 engine. Rocket and spacecraft return together under a colorful 15 inch parachute, ready to prep and launch again.

As for the real Liberty Bell 7, in 1999 after resting silently beneath the Atlantic for 38 years, a recovery team located and raised the spacecraft from its 16,000-foot depth. Now restored, Gus Grissom’s once lost spacecraft is on display in a Kansas museum, a tribute to the memorable, early days of the U.S. space program.

Big Scale Presence That Turns Heads

Laser cut balsa fins, precision fit components, and a thoughtfully engineered airframe make the build engaging without being overwhelming. Most flyers can comfortably complete construction and finishing over a few days.

Quick Release Motor Retention System

The Pro Series II quick release motor retention system makes post flight turnaround fast and simple. Spent motors slide out easily without disassembly, keeping you focused on flying instead of fumbling with hardware between launches.

Classic Heritage with Modern Performance

Originally released around 1990, the Super Big Bertha is a true Estes classic brought back with modern upgrades. Flying one connects you to decades of rocketry tradition while enjoying the reliability, durability, and performance expected from today’s Pro Series II kits.

High Altitude Flights and Gentle Recovery

When powered by recommended mid power engines, the Super Big Bertha reaches projected altitudes of up to 1200 feet, delivering long, exciting flights that are still easy to follow visually. A large parachute recovery system ensures smooth landings and keeps the rocket ready for launch after launch.

title: Saturn V (1:200 scale) Ready to Fly
body_html:
The Estes limited production and commemorative 1:200 scale Apollo II Saturn V model is almost 2 feet tall and comes fully assembled with many scale details and markings carefully reproduced for exceptional realism. This historical model of the Saturn V is suitable for display and celebrates the historic 50th anniversary of landing the first man on the moon!

  • Ready to fly rocket is almost 2 feet tall!
  • Completely assembled with scale details, painting and markings.
  • Includes colorful, pre-assembled 18” parachute for recovery.
  • Saturn V display stand included.

A Truly Historic Rocket!

As the tallest, heaviest and most powerful rocket ever produced, the original Saturn V was a 3-stage rocket that stood 363 feet high (110.6m), weighed approximately 6.2 million pounds and generated 7.6 million pounds of thrust at lift off. At just over 36 stories tall, it stood about 60 feet taller than the Statue of Liberty, making it quite an impressive site on the launch pad.

The Saturn V was at the heart of NASA’s Apollo and Skylab programs as it was able to launch a 45-ton payload beyond low earth orbit, which was necessary for sending men to the moon. A total of 13 Saturn V launches took place between 1967 and 1973, delivering 24 astronauts successfully to the moon and back to earth. The first launch of the Saturn V rocket was during the Apollo 4 mission of 1967, and was a crew-less launch meant to test the rocket. The first launch with a crew occurred in December of 1968 during the Apollo 8 mission which sent astronauts in orbit around the moon but did not land. Apollo 9 added another piece to the puzzle as the moon lander was tested by flying in Earth's orbit, and Apollo 10 saw the lander launch to the moon, testing its space flight again without landing. Then came Apollo 11 in 1969, changing the space race forever!

We were finally able to land astronauts on the moon and take that famous first step into the future. Successful missions followed with the Saturn V rocket, landing astronauts on the moon during Apollo 12, 14, 15, 16, and 17. The last launch of this historic rocket came in 1973 when it was used to launch the Skylab space station into Earth orbit.

With its highly detailed design, this replacement part helps preserve the scale-inspired realism that makes the Saturn V such a favorite among collectors, builders, and spaceflight fans.

Durable Plastic Construction

Made from durable plastic, the Saturn V LEM Shroud is built for reliable replacement and long-lasting display. It is a smart choice for refreshing a well-loved model, completing a repair project, or keeping spare Saturn V parts on hand for future maintenance.

Keep Your Saturn V Mission-Ready

Few rockets inspire the same sense of awe as the Saturn V, and every detail matters when you are restoring or displaying your model. Add the Saturn V LEM Shroud to your build supplies and keep your 1969 Saturn V looking complete, accurate, and ready for its next countdown.

Made to fit the Estes 002160 Saturn V ready-to-fly model, this component ensures both form and function are fully restored. Authentic Replacement Part

Durable and Flight-Ready

Simple to Install

Keep the Legacy Alive

body_html:

With its large diameter and commanding length, this tube helps preserve the bold scale appearance that makes the Saturn V one of the most impressive model rockets ever built.

Restore an Iconic Model Rocket

Whether your original tube was damaged during building, storage, or launch-day adventures, this replacement part helps bring your Saturn V back to form.

Bring Your Saturn V Back to the Pad

From careful restorations to practical repairs, the Saturn V Main Body Tube gives dedicated rocketeers a way to keep a favorite kit looking sharp and ready for its next mission. It is a must-have replacement part for anyone who wants their Saturn V to remain a centerpiece in the workshop, on display, or at the launch field.

title: Green Eggs™ Bulk Pack (12 pk)
body_html:
Introducing the Green Eggs Bulk Pack - the perfect rocket kit for school science projects and STEM classes. Furthermore, it provides a safe and stable flight with a recovery suited for small school size flying fields.

title: Model Rocket Display Cradle
body_html:
The Model Rocket Display Cradle brings both function and convenience to your rocketry experience. Just like full-scale rocketry, having a stable cradle makes all the difference when working on detailed assembly tasks. By holding your rocket securely on its side, it prevents the model from tipping or resting on delicate fins, ensuring precise work and a damage-free finish.

Work Smarter on the Bench

When building your rockets, you’ll often need both hands free for tasks like applying glue, shaping fin fillets, or smoothing decals. The display cradle gives you that stability, holding the rocket steady so you can work confidently and with greater accuracy. Ready for Field Prep

Display Your Fleet

Beyond construction and launch prep, the cradle doubles as an attractive way to showcase your rockets at home, in the classroom, or in a shop display. Whether you’re proud of a favorite build or want to keep your collection organized, the cradle adds both style and protection to your display.
